								elseif mi then 
									if ri.mode~=mi then 
										si:setbind(ai,mi);
									end;
								end;
							end;
							ri=si.ind;
							if ri then 
								local vQ=DQ[li];
								if type(vQ)=="table"then 
									ri.on=vQ.on==true;
									ri.name=type(vQ.n)=="string"and vQ.n or"";
								else 
									ri.on=si.o.ind~=nil and si.o.ind~=false;
									ri.name=type(si.o.ind)=="string"and si.o.ind or"";
								end;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					YQ=iQ.profs;
					for vQ=1,#YQ,1 do 
						fi=YQ[vQ];
						DQ=Ni[fi.id];
						if type(DQ)=="table"then 
							fi:load(DQ);
						else 
							fi.data={};
							fi:apply();
						end;
					end;
					Q(jQ.ui);
					pQ();
					return true;
				end;
				local function Q(jQ,YQ)
					local vQ=aQ({meta={name=jQ,modified=L(),ver=iQ.ver},data=YQ});
					return vQ~=nil and cQ.write(_Q(jQ),vQ);
				end;
				local function jQ(YQ)
					kQ.cfg=YQ;
					cQ.write(iQ.dir.."/last.txt",YQ or"");

				local function YQ(vQ)
					if type(vQ)~="string"then 
						return nil;
					elseif vQ==""then 
						return nil;
					end;
					local DQ=mQ(vQ);
					if DQ then 
					else 
						local Ni,fi=pcall(rQ,vQ);
						DQ=if Ni then(mQ(fi))else DQ;
					end;
					if DQ then 
						if type(DQ.data)=="table"then 
							return DQ.data;
						end;
					end;
					return DQ;
				end;
				local rQ={seen={},busy={},get=false,pack=function(vQ)
					local DQ=YQ(vQ);

						return nil;

						return nil;

							if not(li.o.nocfg)then

							end;

							vQ[Ni]=fi;
						end;
					end;

				end,fail=function(vQ,DQ)
					if vQ==404 then 
						return"Share code {"..tostring(DQ).."} not found";
					elseif vQ==429 then 
						return"Too many share requests, wait a minute";
					elseif vQ==413 then 
						return"Config is too big to share";
					elseif vQ==400 then 
						return"Config can not be shared";
					end;
					return"Share server is not responding";

							vQ[#vQ+1]=fi;
						end;
					end;
					I(vQ);
					return M(vQ,"\0");
				end};

						G.y=C;
						l.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(s,C);
					end;
					if G.size~=z then 
						G.size=z;
						l.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(z,z);
					end;
					if G.rotation~=q then 
						G.rotation=q;
						l.Rotation=q;
					end;
					if G.col~=r then 
						G.col=r;
						l.ImageColor3=r;
					end;
					r=1-(x or 1);
					if G.alpha~=r then 
						G.alpha=r;
						l.ImageTransparency=r;
					end;
					if not(G.shown)then 
						G.shown=true;
						l.Visible=true;
					end;
				end;
				local l,s,C={},0,0;
				local function z()
					local q=Instance.new("ImageLabel");
					q.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5);
					q.BackgroundTransparency=1;
					q.BorderSizePixel=0;
					q.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit;
					q.Visible=false;
					q.ZIndex=41;
					q.Parent=N;
					return{image=q,shown=false};
				end;
				h.avatar=function(N,q,r,x)
					C+=1;
					local G=l[C];
					if G then 
					else 
						G=z();
						s+=1;
						l[s]=G;
					end;
					local z=G.image;
					if G.uid~=x then 
						G.uid=x;
						z.Image="rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id="..tostring(x).."&w=48&h=48";
					end;
					if G.x~=N or G.y~=q then 
						G.x=N;
						G.y=q;
						z.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(N,q);
					end;
					if G.size~=r then 
						G.size=r;
						z.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(r,r);
					end;

						G.shown=true;
						z.Visible=true;
					end;
				end;
				h.close=function()
					local N,z=f+1,t;
					for q=N,z,1 do 
						local r=F[q];
						if r then 
							if r.shown then 
								r.shown=false;
								r.image.Visible=false;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					N,z=C+1,s;
					for q=N,z,1 do 
						local r=l[q];
						if r then 
							if r.shown then 
								r.shown=false;
								r.image.Visible=false;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					z,N=u+1,g;
					for q=z,N,1 do 
						local N=_[q];
						if N then 
							if N.shown then 
								N.shown=false;
								N.image.Visible=false;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					C=0;
				end;
				h.purge=function()
					local N=t;
					for z=N,1,-1 do 
						local q=F[z];
						F[z]=nil;
						if q then 
							pcall(q.image.Destroy,q.image);
						end;
					end;
					N=s;
					for F=N,1,-1 do 
						local z=l[F];
						l[F]=nil;
						if z then 
							pcall(z.image.Destroy,z.image);
						end;
					end;
					N=g;
					for F=N,1,-1 do 
						local N=_[F];
						_[F]=nil;
						if N then 
							pcall(N.image.Destroy,N.image);
						end;
					end;
					t,f,s,C,g,u=0,0,0,0,0,0;
				end;
				R.teardown(h.purge);
				return h;
			end;
			K.x=function()
				local R,_=K.load("b"),K.load("s");
				local N=R.lp;
				local h=table.find;
				local F=os.clock;
				local t=Color3.new().Lerp;
				local f,l=math.sin,{};
				local g=R.weak();
				local u=R.weak();
				l.char_info=function(s)
					local C=u[s];
					if C then 
					else 
						C={};
						u[s]=C;
					end;
					return C;
				end;
				l.shared_for=function(u,s)
					local C=g[s];
					if C then 
					else 
						C={};
						g[s]=C;
					end;
					local g=_.frame();
					if C.frame~=g then 
						C.frame=g;
						C.vis=false;

						C.fr=g;
						local z=u.tSet[g and"fr"or"en"];
						C.opt=z;
						C.clone=u._clones[s];
						g=z.en;
						if(if g then s==N and not u.allowlocal else not g)or s.UserId~=nil and#u.wlist>0 and not h(u.wlist,s.UserId)then 
							C.en=false;
							C.char=nil;
						else 
							z=u.getChar(s);
							C.char=z;
							C.en=z~=nil;
						end;
					end;
					return C;
				end;
				local N=R.weak();
				l.opt_flags=function(R,h)
					R=N[h];
					if R then 
					else 
						R={};
						N[h]=R;
					end;
					local N=_.frame();
					if R.frame~=N then 
						R.frame=N;
						local N,g,u=(h.hb or h.ht)and true or false,(h.ab or h.at)and true or false,(h.bomb or h.scope or h.flashed or h.defuse)and true or false;
						R.hp=N;
						R.arm=g;
						R.wep=(h.wep or h.wepIcon)and true or false;
						R.mon=h.mon and true or false;
						R.pn=h.pn and true or false;
						R.ind=u;
						R.corn=(N or g or u or h.box or h.name or h.av or h.dis or h.wep or h.wepIcon or h.mon or h.pn or h.tr or h.b3d)and true or false;
					end;
					return R;
				end;
				l.grad=function(R,N,h,g)
					return t(R,N,f(h*3.1416+F()*2+(g or 0)*6.283)*0.5+0.5);
				end;
				l.box_col=function(R,N,h,F,f,g)
					return R and t(N,h,(F-f)/g)or N;
				end;
				l.find_part=function(R,N)
					local h=R:FindFirstChild(N);
					if h then 
						if h.Parent==R then 
							if h:IsA("BasePart")then 
								return h;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					return nil;
				end;
				l.draw_line=function(R,N,h,F,t,f)
					if t then 
						if f then 
							local g,u=h(t);
							local t,s=h(f);
							if u then 
								if s then 
									F.From=g;
									F.To=t;
									F.Visible=true;
									F.Color=_.parse_col(R,N.skelCol[1]);
									F.Transparency=N.skelCol[2];
									return true;
								end;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					F.Visible=false;
					return false;
				end;
				return l;
			end;
			K.y=function()
				local R,_,N=K.load("b"),{},{};

						return nil;
					end;

			end;
			K.z=function()
				local R=K.load("s");
				local _=K.load("x");

				local O,j,E=Color3.new(),{bx=0,by=0,lx=0,ly=0,rx=0,ry=0,sb=0,sl=0,sr=0},{bone=function(P,T,Y,v,Z)

					end;

				local function P(T,Y,v)

				end;

				local function G(m,c,T,Y,v,Z)
					for L=1,10,1 do

						N.line(C(m,c,o),C(m,c,X),s(T,Y,(o+X)*0.5),v,Z);
					end;
				end;
				local function m(c,T,Y,v,Z,L,o,X,Q)
					local S=#c;
					if S==0 then 
						return 0;
					end;
					local A=h.bounds(v,c);
					local J=T-A*0.5;
					for T=1,S,1 do 
						local y,e=z(c,T,T),S>1 and(T-1)/(S-1)or 0;
						T=_.grad(o,X,e,Q);
						if Z then 
							N.outlined_text(q(J,Y),v,T,L,Z,L,y,false);
						else 
							N.text(q(J,Y),v,T,L,y,false);
						end;
						J+=h.bounds(v,y);
					end;
					return A;
				end;
				E.grad_text=m;
				E.place=function(z,c,T,Y,v,Z,L,o,X,Q)
					local S,A=h.bounds(Y,c);
					local J,y;
					if T=="left"then 
						J,y=j.lx-S*0.5,j.ly+j.sl+A*0.5;
						j.sl=j.sl+(A+2);
					else

							J,y=j.rx+S*0.5,j.ry+j.sr+A*0.5;

				local function z(c,T,Y,v,Z,L,o,X,Q)
					local S,A=T.tl,T.br;
					local J,y,e,M=S.X,S.Y,A.X-1,A.Y-1;

					elseif A<=0 then

					end;

					T,c=if T<1 then 1 else T,if c<1 then 1 else c;

						N.filled_rect(q(e-1,M-c),q(3,c+2),o,Q);

							end;

						end;
					else

					if Y then

						Q=v.armMax or 100;
						X=u(T.arm/Q,0,1);

						else

						end;
						if v.at then 
							S=l(T.arm).."ap";
							local u,G=h.bounds(o,S);
							I=C(M,s,X);
							local s,C;
							if k=="h"then

							else

					if P.Parent~=T then

						return false;
					end;
					if not(P:IsA("BasePart"))then 
						return false;
					end;
					T=P.Size;
					return T.X>0.05 and T.Y>0.05 and T.Z>0.05;
				end;
				local function O(P)
					local T=P:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh");
					if T then 
						P=T.Scale;
						if typeof(P)=="Vector3"then 
							return P;
						end;
					end;
					return nil;
				end;
				local function P(T,Y)
					local v,Z=T.Size,T.Name;
					local L=v;
					if Z=="Head"then 
						local o=O(T);
						v=if o then L*o else L;
						return if Y~=1 then v*Y else v;
					end;
					Y=O(T);
					if Y then 
						return L*Y;
					end;
					T=z[Z];
					if T then 
						return L*T;
					end;
					v,Z,T=L.X,L.Y,L.Z;
					if Z>=v then 
						if Z>=T then 
							return s(v*1,Z*1.08,T*1);
						end;
					end;
					if v>=Z then 
						if v>=T then 
							return s(v*1.08,Z*1,T*1);
						end;
					end;
					return s(v*1,Z*1,T*1.08);
				end;
				j.new=function(s,z)
					return setmetatable({plr=s,itf=z,parts={},slots=R.weak(),links={},charRef=nil,shown=false,armed=false,fill_col=nil,glow_col=nil,head_trim=1},j);
				end;
				j.drop_part=function(R,s)
					local z=R.slots[s];
					if not(z)then 
						return;
					end;
					R.slots[s]=nil;
					if z.glow then 
						pcall(z.glow.Destroy,z.glow);
					end;
					if z.fill then 
						pcall(z.fill.Destroy,z.fill);
					end;
				end;
				local function R(s)
					local z=Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment");
					z.Adornee=G;
					z.Transparency=0;
					z.ZIndex=s;
					z.Visible=false;
					if q then 
						z.Shading=q;
					end;
					if r then 
						z.AdornCullingMode=r;
					end;
					z.Parent=x;
					return z;
				end;
				j.add_part=function(s,z)
					if s.slots[z]then 
						return;
					elseif not(E(z,s.charRef))then 
						return;
					end;
					local q={glow=nil,fill=nil,base=P(z,s.head_trim),size=z.Size};
					if s.armed then 
						local r,G=R(0),R(1);
						r.Color3=s.glow_col or l;
						G.Color3=s.fill_col or l;
						r.Visible=s.shown;
						G.Visible=s.shown;
						q.glow=r;
						q.fill=G;
						s.fade=nil;
					end;
					local r=#s.parts+1;
					s.parts[r]=z;
					s.slots[z]=q;
				end;
				j.arm=function(s)
					if s.armed then 
						return;
					end;
					s.armed=true;
					local z,q,r,G=s.parts,s.slots,s.fill_col or l,s.glow_col or l;
					for O=1,#z,1 do 
						s=q[z[O]];
						if s then 
							if not(s.fill)then 
								local z,q=R(0),R(1);
								z.Color3=G;
								q.Color3=r;
								z.Visible=false;
								q.Visible=false;
								s.glow=z;
								s.fill=q;
							end;
						end;
					end;
				end;
				j.clear=function(R)
					local s=R.links;
					for z=#s,1,-1 do 
						pcall(s[z].Disconnect,s[z]);
						s[z]=nil;
					end;
					s=R.parts;
					for z=#s,1,-1 do 
						R:drop_part(s[z]);
						s[z]=nil;
					end;
					table.clear(R.slots);
					R.charRef=nil;
					R.shown=false;
					R.armed=false;
					R.fade=nil;
				end;
				j.bind=function(R,s)
					R:clear();
					if not s or not s.Parent then 
						return;
					end;
					R.charRef=s;
					R.head_trim=C[R.itf.getTeam(R.plr)]and 0.88 or 1;
					local C=s:GetChildren();
					for z=1,#C,1 do 
						R:add_part(C[z]);
					end;
					C=R.links;
					C[#C+1]=s.ChildAdded:Connect(function(z)
						if R.charRef==s then 
							R:add_part(z);
						end;
					end);
					C[#C+1]=s.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(C)
						if R.charRef==s then 
							R:drop_part(C);
						end;
					end);
				end;
				j.rescan=function(R)
					if not(R.charRef)then 
						return;
					end;
					local s,C,z=R.parts,R.slots,0;
					for q=1,#s,1 do 
						local r=s[q];
						q=r and C[r];
						if r then 
							if r.Parent then 
								if q then 
									local C=z+1;
									s[C]=r;
									local G=r.Size;
									if q.size~=G then 
										q.size=G;
										q.base=P(r,R.head_trim);
									end;
									z=C;
								else 
									if r then 
										R:drop_part(r);
									end;
								end;
							else 
								if r then 
									R:drop_part(r);
								end;
							end;
						else 
							if r then 
								R:drop_part(r);
							end;
						end;
					end;
					for R=#s,z+1,-1 do 
						s[R]=nil;
					end;
				end;
				j.set_shown=function(R,s)
					R.shown=s;
					local C,z=R.parts,R.slots;
					for q=1,#C,1 do 
						R=z[C[q]];
						if R then 
							if R.fill then 
								R.glow.Visible=s;
								R.fill.Visible=s;
							end;
						end;
					end;
				end;
				j.recolor=function(R,s,C)
					R.fill_col=s;
					R.glow_col=C;
					local z,q=R.parts,R.slots;
					for r=1,#z,1 do 
						R=q[z[r]];
						if R then 
							if R.fill then 
								R.fill.Color3=s;
								R.glow.Color3=C;
							end;
						end;
					end;
				end;
				j.update=function(R)
					local s=R.itf;
					local C=h.shared_for(s,R.plr);
					local h,z=C.opt,C.char;
					local q=C.en and h and h.chams and z and z.Parent and R.plr~=f;
					if if q then not x else not q then 
						if R.charRef then 
							R:clear();
						end;
						return;
					end;
					if R.charRef~=z then 
						R:bind(z);
					end;
					if n then 
						R:rescan();
					end;
					z,q=R.parts,R.slots;
					local f,r=#z;
					for x=1,f,1 do 
						C=z[x];
						if C then 
							if C.Parent then 
								r=C;
								break;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					C=r~=nil;
					if C then 
						local x=s.shSet;
						local G=tonumber(x.maxDis);
						if G then 
							if x.limDis then 
								local x=c;
								C=if(x-r.Position).Magnitude>G then false else C;
							else 
							end;
						else 
						end;
					else 
					end;
					if not C then 
						if R.shown then 
							R:set_shown(false);
						end;
						return;
					end;
					if not(R.armed)then 
						R:arm();
					end;
					if not(R.shown)then 
						R:set_shown(true);
					end;
					C=N.parse_col(R,h.chamsOCol[1])or l;
					s=a(C,t(h));
					if R.fill_col~=C then 
						R:recolor(C,s);
					elseif R.glow_col~=s then 
						R:recolor(C,s);
					end;
					C=F.fade(R.plr);
					if R.fade~=C then 
						R.fade=C;

						for N=1,f,1 do 
							h=q[z[N]];
							if h then 
								if h.fill then 
									h.fill.Transparency=s;
									h.glow.Transparency=s;
								end;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					for N=1,f,1 do 
						R=z[N];
						C=R and q[R];
						if C then 
							if R.Parent then 
								h=m;
								s=h*R.CFrame;
								N=s.Position;
								local R=g(0.6/u(N.Magnitude,0.001),1);
								local h,F,t=CFrame.new(N*R)*(s-N),(C.base*R):Max(_),C.fill;
								t.CFrame=h;
								t.Size=F;
								R=C.glow;
								R.CFrame=h;
								R.Size=F*1.12;
							end;
						end;
					end;
				end;
				j.destroy=function(R)
					R:clear();

					end;

					f:drop_links();
					if not(l)then 
						return;
					end;
					local g=f.links;

						f.dirty=true;
					end;
					g[1]=l.ChildAdded:Connect(u);
					g[2]=l.ChildRemoved:Connect(u);
				end;

					local l=f.inst;
					if f.on then 
						f.on=false;
						if l then 
							l.Enabled=false;
						end;
					elseif l then 
						if l.Enabled then 
							f.on=false;
							if l then 
								l.Enabled=false;
							end;
						end;
					end;
				end;
				t.unbind=function(f)
					f:hide();
					f:drop_links();
					f.char=nil;
					f.root=nil;
					f.dirty=false;

					if l then 
						l.Adornee=nil;
					end;
				end;
				t.ensure=function(f)
					local l,g=f.inst,_.holder;
					if l then 
						if l.Parent==g then 
							return l;
						end;
					end;
					if l then 
						pcall(l.Destroy,l);
					end;
					l=Instance.new("Highlight");
					l.Enabled=false;
					l.DepthMode=F;
					l.Parent=g;
					f.inst=l;
					f.char=nil;
					f.on=false;
					f.fc=nil;
					f.oc=nil;
					f.ft=nil;
					f.ot=nil;

				t.update=function(F)
					local f=F.itf;
					local l=N.shared_for(f,F.plr);
					local N,g,u=l.opt,l.char,l.en;
					if(if u then not N else not u)or not N.hlt or not g or not g.Parent or F.plr==h then

						end;

						f=tonumber(g.maxDis);
						if f then 
							if(_.view_frame().Position-l.Position).Magnitude>f then 
								F:hide();
								return;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					l,g=N.hltFCol,N.hltOCol;
					local N,h,f,s=_.parse_col(F,l[1])or R,_.parse_col(F,g[1])or R,1-(tonumber(l[2])or 0.5),1-(tonumber(g[2])or 1);
					if F.fc~=N then 
						F.fc=N;
						u.FillColor=N;
					end;
					if F.oc~=h then 
						F.oc=h;
						u.OutlineColor=h;
					end;
					if F.ft~=f then 
						F.ft=f;
						u.FillTransparency=f;
					end;
					if F.ot~=s then 
						F.ot=s;
						u.OutlineTransparency=s;
					end;
					if F.on then 
						if not(u.Enabled)then 
							F.on=true;
							u.Enabled=true;
						end;
					else 
						F.on=true;
						u.Enabled=true;
					end;
				end;
				t.destroy=function(R)
					R:drop_links();
					local _=R.inst;
					R.inst=nil;
					R.char=nil;
					R.root=nil;
					R.dirty=false;
					R.on=false;
					if _ then 
						pcall(_.Destroy,_);
					end;
				end;
				return t;

				local function s()
					if type(j)~="table"then 
						return nil;
					elseif type(j.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement)~="function"then 
						return nil;
					end;
					local C,a=pcall(j.peekCurrentEquippedForMovement);
					if C then 
						if a then 
							if a.IsDestroyed then 
								return nil;
							elseif a.IsEquipped==false then 
								return nil;
							end;
						else 
							return nil;
						end;
					else 
						return nil;
					end;
					C=a.Properties;
					if C then 
						if C.Class~="Grenade"then 
							return nil;
						elseif not(h[a.Name])then 
							return nil;
						end;
					else 
						return nil;
					end;
					return a;
				end;
				local function C(a)

						if m then 
							if typeof(c)=="Vector3"then

				local function l(Q,B,d,b)

							end;

				N:toggle({name="fill gradient",flag="trig.dfov_fgrad",cb=t}):color({flag="trig.dfov_fcol2",default=h,cb=t});
				_:slider({name="min damage",flag="trig.mindmg",min=0,max=150,cb=t}):dep(U);
				_:slider({name="hit chance",flag="trig.hc",min=1,max=100,default=70,suffix="%",cb=t}):dep(U);
				_:toggle({name="auto wall",flag="trig.aw",cb=t}):dep(U):settings():slider({name="min damage",flag="trig.awmindmg",min=0,max=150,cb=t});
				return true;
			end;
			K.aD=function()
				local U,R=K.load("b"),K.load("a");
				local _,N=K.load("e"),U.lp;
				local h=U.players;
				local F=U.workspace;
				local U=_.lib;
				local _=string.lower;
				local t=math.max;
				local f,l,g=math.floor,{},false;
				local function u(s,C)
					local z=s:GetAttribute("LastKiller")==N.Name;
					if z~=(C:GetAttribute("LastKiller")==N.Name)then 
						return z;
					end;
					return _(s.DisplayName.."\0"..s.Name)<_(C.DisplayName.."\0"..C.Name);
				end;
				local function _()
					local s,C={},t(0,f(tonumber(N:GetAttribute("Spectators"))or 0));
					if C==0 then 
						return s;
					end;
					local t,f=N:GetAttribute("Team"),F:GetAttribute("ServerGamemode")=="Competitive";
					for F,F in h:GetPlayers()do 
						if F~=N then 
							if F.Parent==h then 
								if F:GetAttribute("IsSpectating")==true then 
									if f then 
										if t then 
											if t=="Spectators"then 
												s[#s+1]=F;
											elseif F:GetAttribute("Team")==t then 
												s[#s+1]=F;
											end;
										else 
											s[#s+1]=F;
										end;
									else 
										s[#s+1]=F;
									end;
								end;
							end;
						end;
					end;
					table.sort(s,u);
					for F=#s,C+1,-1 do 
						s[F]=nil;
					end;
					return s;
				end;
				local function F()
					if g then 
						return;
					elseif not(R.alive())then 
						return;
					end;
					g=true;
					task.defer(function()
						g=false;
						if R.alive()then 
							pcall(U.spectators,U,_());
						end;
					end);
				end;
				local function U(_)
					if _==N then 
						return;
					elseif l[_]then 
						return;
					end;
					l[_]=_:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsSpectating"):Connect(F);
				end;
				for _,_ in h:GetPlayers()do 
					U(_);
				end;
				R.connect(N:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Spectators"),F);
				R.connect(h.PlayerAdded,function(_)
					U(_);
					F();
				end);
				R.connect(h.PlayerRemoving,function(U)
					local _=l[U];
					if _ then 
						_:Disconnect();
						l[U]=nil;
					end;
					F();
				end);
				R.teardown(function()
					for U,R in l,nil,nil do 
						R:Disconnect();
						l[U]=nil;
					end;
				end);
				F();
				return true;
			end;
			-- ZRHUB: only the silent aim + movement parts are started, no shitaro menu
			local U=K.load("a");
			U.takeover();
			local reclaim=K.load("b").reclaim;
			local out={};
			local function need(name)
				local ok,mod=pcall(K.load,name);
				if not ok then warn("[ZRHUB] silent aim part "..name.." failed: "..tostring(mod)); return nil; end;
				return mod;
			end;
			out.aim=need("af");
			out.weapons=need("ak");
			out.pred=need("aj");
			local fx=need("p");
			need("ai");
			need("am");
			local fire=need("ao");
			local auto=need("ap");
			local circle=need("ar");
			local mv=need("V");
			out.move=mv and mv.cfg or {};
			local function E(P)
				if P then pcall(P); end;
				pcall(reclaim);
			end;
			local function beat()
				E(auto and auto.auto);
			end;
			local function early()
				E(fx and fx.step);
				E(fire and fire.step);
				E(circle and circle.step);
			end;
			U.connect(K.load("b").run.Heartbeat,beat);
			U.bind(Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+3,early);
			U.publish(U.release);
			out.release=U.release;
			return out;
		end;
	end;
end)(__devirt_support)()(...)
end

function ZR_LoadZaml()
local u, L, O = game:GetService'Players', game:GetService'ReplicatedStorage', game:GetService'RunService'
local _ = u.LocalPlayer

do
    local function d(aa)
        local ab = type(aa) == 'table' and rawget(aa, 'gethui')

        if type(ab) ~= 'function' or rawget(aa, 'zamlhui') then
            return
        end

        local ac, ad = pcall(ab)

        if not (ac and (typeof(ad) == 'Instance' and ad:IsA'LayerCollector')) then
            return
        end

        rawset(aa, 'zamlhui', true)
        rawset(aa, 'gethui', function()
            local ae = ab()

            if typeof(ae) == 'Instance' and ae:IsA'LayerCollector' then
                return ae.Parent or game:GetService'CoreGui'
            end

            return ae
        end)
    end

    pcall(d, getfenv and getfenv(1))
    pcall(d, getgenv and getgenv())
end

local aa = {
    unloaded = false,
    conns = {},
    cleanups = {},
}

do
    local ab = getgenv and getgenv() or _G

    if type(ab.zaml) == 'table' and type(ab.zaml.unload) == 'function' then
        pcall(ab.zaml.unload)
    end
    if type(ab.__zamlbloxUnload) == 'function' then
        pcall(ab.__zamlbloxUnload)
    end

    function aa.connect(ac, ad)
        local ae, af = ac:Connect(ad), aa.conns

        af[#af + 1] = ae

        if #af % 200 == 0 then
            local ag = {}

            for ah, ai in ipairs(af)do
                if ai.Connected then
                    ag[#ag + 1] = ai
                end
            end

            aa.conns = ag
        end
        if aa.unloaded then
            ae:Disconnect()
        end

        return ae
    end
    function aa.onUnload(ac)
        aa.cleanups[#aa.cleanups + 1] = ac
    end
    function aa.unload()
        if aa.unloaded then
            return
        end

        aa.unloaded = true

        for ac, ad in ipairs(aa.conns)do
            pcall(function()
                ad:Disconnect()
            end)
        end

        aa.conns = {}

        for ac = #aa.cleanups, 1, -1 do
            pcall(aa.cleanups[ac])
        end

        aa.cleanups = {}

        if type(ab.zaml) == 'table' and ab.zaml.unload == aa.unload then
            ab.zaml = nil
        end
    end

    ab.__zamlbloxUnload = nil
    ab.zaml = {
        unload = aa.unload,
    }
end

local ab = true

do
    local ac, ad = 'ZamlbloxHubHandle', {}

    pcall(function()
        ad[#ad + 1] = game:GetService'CoreGui'
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if gethui then
            ad[#ad + 1] = gethui()
        end
    end)

    for ae, af in ipairs(ad)do
        local ag = af:FindFirstChild(ac)

        if ag and ag:IsA'BindableFunction' then
            pcall(function()
                ag:Invoke()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                ag:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end

    if setthreadidentity then
        pcall(setthreadidentity, 8)
    end

    local ae = Instance.new'BindableFunction'

    ae.Name = ac
    ae.OnInvoke = function()
        aa.unload()
    end
    ae.Parent = ad[1]

    aa.onUnload(function()
        pcall(function()
            ae:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end
do
    local ac = {
        WindUI = true,

        if not ad then
            return
        end

        for ae, af in ipairs(ad:GetChildren())do
            if ac[af.Name] then
                pcall(function()
                    af:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        E(gethui and gethui())
    end)
    pcall(function()
        E(game:GetService'CoreGui')
    end)
    pcall(function()
        E(_:FindFirstChildOfClass'PlayerGui')
    end)
end

local function j()
    local aI = workspace:GetAttribute'ServerGamemode'

    if aI == 'Casual' or aI == 'Deathmatch' then
        return ay.CasualDeathmatch or ay.Default
    elseif aI == 'Surf' then

do
    local aI, aJ = pcall(require, L.Components.Common.Participants)

    if not aI or type(aJ) ~= 'table' or type(aJ.GetAll) ~= 'function' then
        aJ = nil
    end

    local aK = getthreadidentity or syn and syn.get_thread_identity

    local function z(aL, ...)
        local aM, aN, aO = aK and aK(), pcall(aL, ...)

        if aM and setthreadidentity then
            pcall(setthreadidentity, aM)
        end

        return aN, aO
    end

    local aL = {}

    local function R(aM)
        local aN = aL[aM]

        if aN then
            return aN
        end

        aN = setmetatable({
            IsBot = true,
            UserId = 0,
        }, {
            __index = function(aO, aP)
                if aP == 'Character' then
                    local aQ, aR = z(aJ.Character, aM)

                    return aQ and aR or nil
                elseif aP == 'Name' or aP == 'DisplayName' then
                    local aQ, aR = z(aJ.Name, aM)

                    return (aQ and type(aR) == 'string') and aR or aM.Name
                elseif aP == 'Parent' then
                    return aM.Parent
                end

                return nil
            end,
        })

        function aN.GetAttribute(aO, aP)
            local aQ = aM:GetAttribute(aP)

            if aQ == nil then
                local aR, aS = z(aJ.Character, aM)

                if aR and aS then
                    aQ = aS:GetAttribute(aP)
                end
            end

            return aQ
        end

        aL[aM] = aN

        return aN
    end

    local aM, aN = (-1)

    function aa.entities()
        local aO = os.clock()

        if aN and aO - aM < 0.2 then
            return aN
        end

        aM = aO

        local aP, aQ, aR = nil, false

        if aJ then
            aQ, aR = z(aJ.GetAll)
        end
        if aQ and type(aR) == 'table' then
            aP = {}

            for aS, aU in pairs(aR)do

                    aP[#aP + 1] = aU:IsA'Player' and aU or R(aU)

            if aQ and type(aR) == 'table' then
                for aS, aU in pairs(aR)do

                    end
                end

                return aP
            end
        end

        local aQ = workspace:FindFirstChild'HordeShells'

        for aR, aS in ipairs(aQ and aQ:GetChildren() or {})do
            if aS:IsA'Model' and (aS:GetAttribute'HordeId' ~= nil and (not aS:GetAttribute'Ragdolled' and aS:FindFirstChild'Head')) then

            IsBot = true,
            UserId = 0,
            Name = 'zombie',
            DisplayName = 'zombie',
            Character = aQ,
            Parent = aQ.Parent,

        end

        aP[aQ] = aR

        return aR
    end
    function aa.ownerOf(aQ)
        if not aQ then

        end

    end
    function aa.byName(aQ)

        end

        return nil
    end

end
local function h(aI)
    if aI == _ then
        return false
    end
    if type(aI) == 'table' and aI.IsZombie then
        return true
    end
    if workspace:FindFirstChild'HordeShells' then
        return false
    end
    if not aC.teamCheck then
        return true
    end
    if workspace:GetAttribute'Gamemode' == 'Deathmatch' then
        return true
    end

    local aJ = aI:GetAttribute'Team'

    return (aJ == 'Terrorists' or aJ == 'Counter-Terrorists') and aJ ~= _:GetAttribute'Team'
end
local function F(aI, aJ)
    local aK = aI.Character

    if not aK or aK:GetAttribute'Dead' or aK:GetAttribute'Ragdolled' then
        return nil
    end

    local aL = aK:GetAttribute'Health'

    if type(aL) == 'number' and aL <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    if not aK:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return nil
    end
    if not aK:FindFirstChild(aJ or 'Head') then
        return nil
    end

    return aK
end
local function t(aI)
    if aI == nil then
        return false
    end
    if aI:GetAttribute'Invincible' == true then
        return true
    end

    local aJ = aa.ownerOf(aI)

    return aJ ~= nil and aJ:GetAttribute'Invincible' == true
end

    end)

function aa.hookSpeedPenalty()
    if aa.unloaded or aa.speedPenaltyHooked then
        return
    end

    aa.speedPenaltyHooked = true

    local aS

    for aU, aV in ipairs(getgc(true))do
        if type(aV) == 'table' then
            local aW, aX = pcall(rawget, aV, '_accumulatorSeconds')

            if aW and (type(aX) == 'number' and type(rawget(aV, '_options')) == 'table') then
                aS = aV

                break
            end
        end
    end

    local aU = aS and aS._options

    if aU then
        aU.__zbScoped = rawget(aU, '__zbScoped') or aU.ResolveScopedState
        aU.__zbBaseSpeed = rawget(aU, '__zbBaseSpeed') or aU.ResolveBaseMoveSpeed

        local aV, aW, aX = aU.__zbScoped, aU.__zbBaseSpeed, ay.Default and ay.Default.MaxBaseMoveSpeed or 19.5

        if aV then
            aU.ResolveScopedState = function(...)
                if not aa.unloaded and aC.noSpeedPenalty then
                    return false
                end

                return aV(...)
            end
        end
        if aW then
            aU.ResolveBaseMoveSpeed = function(...)
                local aY, aZ = aW(...)

                if not aa.unloaded and (aC.noSpeedPenalty and (type(aY) == 'number' and aY > 0)) then
                    aY = math.max(aY, aX)
                end

                return aY, aZ
            end
        end

        aa.onUnload(function()
            if aV then
                aU.ResolveScopedState = aV
            end
            if aW then
                aU.ResolveBaseMoveSpeed = aW
            end
        end)
    else
        aa.speedPenaltyHooked = false
    end
end

local function EU(ba)

end
