                bd[bg] = bj

                if aC.backtrack then
                    local bl = bb[bg]

                    if not bl then
                        bl = {}
                        bb[bg] = bl
                    end

                    local bm = {
                        t = os.clock(),
                        pos = {},
                    }

                    for bn, bo in ipairs(aV)do
                        local bp = bh:FindFirstChild(bo)

                        if bp then
                            bm.pos[bo] = bp.Position
                        end
                    end

                    bm.pos.HumanoidRootPart = bj
                    bl[#bl + 1] = bm

                    while bl[1] and bm.t - bl[1].t > bc do
                        table.remove(bl, 1)
                    end
                elseif bb[bg] then
                    bb[bg] = nil
                end
            else
                bd[bg], ba[bg] = nil, nil
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function zU(bd)
    local be = aC.predictMs or 0

    if be <= 0 or not bd.Parent then
        return bd.Position
    end

    local bf = aa.ownerOf(bd.Parent)
    local bg = bf and ba[bf]

    if not bg then
        return bd.Position
    end

    return bd.Position + Vector3.new(bg.X, bg.Y * 0.5, bg.Z) * (be / 1000)
end
local function xU(bd, be, bf, bg)
    local bh = bd.Properties

    if not (bh and (bd.Identifier and be)) then
        return false
    end

    local bi = a7.server

    if bi then
        bg = nil
    end

    local bj, bk, bl, bm = {}, not bg and EU(be) or LT(), bh.Range or 500, uT(bh)
    local bn, bo = ((bg or zU(be)) - bk).Unit, {}

    for bp = 1, math.max(bh.BulletsPerShot or 1, 1), 1 do
        local bq

        if bg then
            bq = jT(bk, bg, be, bl, bm, bf)

            if not bq then
                return false
            end
        else
            bq = DT(bk, bn, bl, bm, be, bf)
        end
        if bi then
            local br = bq[#bq]

            if not (br and (br.Instance and br.Instance:IsDescendantOf(be.Parent))) then
                return false
            end

            bo[#bo + 1] = {
                Direction = bn,
                Origin = bk,
            }
        else
            bo[#bo + 1] = {
                Direction = bn,
                Origin = bk,
                Hits = kT(bk, bq),
            }
        end

        bj[#bj + 1] = bq
    end

    bd.ShotSeq = (bd.ShotSeq or 0) + 1

    local bp = {
        IsSniperScoped = bd.IsSniperScoped,
        ShootingHand = bd.ShootingHand,
        Identifier = bd.Identifier,
        Seq = bd.ShotSeq,
        Bullets = bo,
        ViewTick = bi and a7.viewTick() or nil,
        __zamlblox = bj,
    }
    local bq = pcall(a2.Inventory.ShootWeapon.Send, bp)

    if bq then
        bd.Rounds = math.max((bd.Rounds or 1) - 1, 0)
        bd.RechargeStartTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

        OT(bd)
    end

    return bq
end

local bd = require(L.Database.Components.GameState)

local function lU()
    if not aC.killAllWaitRound then
        return true
    end

    local be, bf = pcall(bd.GetStateAtTime, workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + (aC.killAllLeadMs or 0) / 1000)

    return be and bf == 'Round In Progress'
end
local function rU(be, bf, bg)
    local bh = be.Properties
    local bi, bj = bh and bh.Range or 3, (U()).Position
    local bk = bg.Position - bj
    local bl = bk.Magnitude > 0 and bk.Unit or (U()).LookVector
    local bm = pcall(a2.Melee.MeleeAttack.Send, {
        Direction = bl * bi,
        Material = bg.Material.Name,
        Distance = math.min(bk.Magnitude, bi),
        Instance = bg,
        Position = bg.Position,
        Normal = -bl,
        MeleeAttack = 'BackStab',
        Identifier = be.Identifier,
    })

    if bm then
        a_.shot(bf, bg.Name)
    end

    return bm
end

do
    local be = setmetatable({}, {
        __mode = 'k',
    })

    aa.connect(O.Heartbeat, function()
        if not aC.knifeKillAll or m() or not lU() then
            return
        end

        local bf = p()
        local bg = bf and bf.Properties

        if not (bg and (bf.Identifier and (not bf.Bullet and bg.Class == 'Melee'))) then
            return
        end

        local bh, bi = (U()).Position, os.clock()

        for bj, bk in ipairs(aa.entities())do
            if ET(bk) then
                local bl = F(bk, 'UpperTorso')

                if bl and (not t(bl) and bi - (be[bk] or 0) >= aC.killAllDelay) then
                    local bm = bl.UpperTorso

                    if (bm.Position - bh).Magnitude <= aC.knifeReach then
                        if rU(bf, bk, bm) then
                            be[bk] = bi
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function yU(be)
    local bf = be.Properties

    if not (bf and (bf.Rounds and be.Identifier)) then
        return false
    end

    local bg, bh, bi = workspace:GetAttribute'Gamemode' == 'Deathmatch', be.Capacity or 0, bf.Rounds - (be.Rounds or 0)
    local bj = bg and bi or math.min(bi, bh)

    if bj <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    local bk = pcall(a2.Inventory.ReloadWeapon.Send, {
        Identifier = be.Identifier,
        Capacity = bh,
        Rounds = be.Rounds,
    })

    if bk then
        be.Rounds = (be.Rounds or 0) + bj

        if not bg then
            be.Capacity = bh - bj
        end
    end

    return bk
end

local be = setmetatable({}, {
    __mode = 'k',
})

local function qU(bf)
    local bg = bf and bf.WeaponEquippedTick

    if type(bg) ~= 'number' then
        return true
    end

    local bh = be[bf]

    if not bh then
        bh = 0.5

        pcall(function()
            local bi = bf.Viewmodel.Animation:getAnimation'Equip'

            if bi and (type(bi.Length) == 'number' and bi.Length > 0) then
                bh = bi.Length
                be[bf] = bh
            end
        end)
    end

    return tick() - bg > bh * 0.925 + 0.03
end
local function vU(bf, bg)
    if bf then
        if mouse1release then
            mouse1release()
        end
        if mouse1press then
            mouse1press()
        end
    elseif FT(bg) and mouse2click then
        mouse2click()
    elseif mouse1click then
        mouse1click()
    end
end

local bf, bg, bh

do
    local bi = {
        Head = {
            'Head',
        },
        Body = {
            'UpperTorso',
            'LowerTorso',
            'HumanoidRootPart',
        },
        Multipoint = {
            'Head',
            'UpperTorso',
            'LowerTorso',
            'HumanoidRootPart',
        },
        ['Full Body'] = aV,
    }

    local function E(bj, bk, bl, bm, bn)
        local bo = (bk.Position - bj).Unit
        local bp, bq, br = UT(bj, bo, bn, bm, bl)

        if bq then
            if br > 0 and (not aC.rageAutowall and (a7.server or not aC.wallbang and not aC.wallLimit)) then
                return false, 0
            end

            return true, br
        end
        if aC.wallbang and not a7.server then
            local bs, bt, bu = UT(bj, bo, bn, math.huge, bl)

            return true, bu
        end

        return false, 0
    end

    local bj = 0.075

    local function z(bk)
        local bl = bk:GetAttribute'Armor'

        if type(bl) ~= 'string' then
            return 0, false
        end

        local bm, bn = pcall(ar.JSONDecode, ar, bl)

        if not bm or type(bn) ~= 'table' then
            return 0, false
        end

        return tonumber(bn.Health) or 0, type(bn.Type) == 'string' and bn.Type:find'Helmet' ~= nil
    end
    local function x(bk, bl, bm, bn, bo)
        local bp, bq = aW[bl], bk.DamagePerPart

        if not bp or type(bq) ~= 'table' or not bq[bp] then
            return 0
        end

        local br = bq[bp]

        br = br * (bk.RangeModifier or 1) ^ ((bm / bj) / 500)

        if bn > 0 then
            br = br * (bk.WallbangMultiplier or 0.5) ^ bn
        end

        local bs, bt = z(bo)

        if bs > 0 and (bp ~= 'Legs' and (bp ~= 'Head' or bt)) then
            br = br * (bk.ArmorPenetration or 1)
        end

        return br * (bk.BulletsPerShot or 1)
    end
    local function R(bk, bl, bm, bn)
        local bo = aZ.key(bk, aW[bl], bm)

        if a7.server then
            return bn, bo
        end

        return bn * aZ.get(bo), bo
    end
    local function l()
        return aC.minDmgOverride and aC.minDmgOverrideValue or aC.minDmg
    end

    local bk, bl, bm = nil, 0.004, 1

    local function q(bn)
        local bo, bp, bq = os.clock(), LT(), bn.Properties
        local br, bs, bt = uT(bq), bq.Range or 500, bi[aC.rageHitbox] or bi.Head

        if aC.forceBody then
            bt = bi.Body
        end

        local bu, bv, bw = l(), {}, at.ViewportSize / 2

        for bx, by in ipairs(aa.entities())do
            if ET(by) then
                local bz = F(by, 'HumanoidRootPart')

                if bz and not t(bz) then
                    local bA = (bz.HumanoidRootPart.Position - bp).Magnitude

                    if bA < aC.rageMaxDist then
                        local bB = {
                            player = by,
                            char = bz,
                            dist = bA,
                            hp = tonumber(bz:GetAttribute'Health') or 100,
                        }

                        if aC.rageTargetMode == 'Crosshair' then
                            bB.score = bT(bz.HumanoidRootPart.Position, bw) or math.huge
                        elseif aC.rageTargetMode == 'Lowest HP' then
                            bB.score = bB.hp + bA / 10000
                        else
                            bB.score = bA
                        end
                        if aC.rageSticky and by == bk then
                            bB.score = -math.huge
                        end

                        bv[#bv + 1] = bB
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(bv, function(bx, by)
            return bx.score < by.score
        end)

        aC.rageCands = #bv

        local bx, by = {}, #bv
        local bz = bm <= by and bm or 1

        bm = 1

        for bA = 0, by - 1, 1 do
            local bB = ((bz - 1) + bA) % by + 1
            local bC = bv[bB]

            if bA > 0 and os.clock() - bo > bl then
                bm = bB

                break
            end

            local bD, bE = bC.hp, bt

            if aC.missAdapt and (aK[bC.player] or 0) >= aC.missesToBody then
                bE = bi.Body
            end

            local bF, bG = {dmg = 0}, {dmg = 0}

            for bH, bI in ipairs(bE)do
                local bJ = bC.char:FindFirstChild(bI)

                if bJ then
                    local bK = EU(bJ)
                    local bL, bM = bK ~= nil, 0

                    if not bK then
                        bK = bp
                        bL, bM = E(bp, bJ, bC.char, br, bs)

                        if bL and (aC.wallLimit and bM > aC.maxWalls) then
                            bL = false
                        end
                    end
                    if bL then
                        local bN, bO = bK ~= bp and 'TP' or nil, x(bq, bI, (bJ.Position - bK).Magnitude, (aC.wallLimit and not a7.server) and 0 or bM, bC.player)
                        local bP, bQ = R(bn.Name, bI, bM, bO)

                        if bP > bF.dmg then
                            bF = {
                                part = bJ,
                                dmg = bP,
                                raw = bO,
                                key = bQ,
                                walls = bM,
                                track = bN,
                            }
                        end
                        if aW[bI] == 'Torso' and bP > bG.dmg then
                            bG = {
                                part = bJ,
                                dmg = bP,
                                raw = bO,
                                key = bQ,
                                walls = bM,
                                track = bN,
                            }
                        end
                        if bG.dmg >= bD or bF.dmg >= bD and not aC.preferBodyLethal then
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if aC.preferBodyLethal and (bG.part and bG.dmg >= bD) then
                bF = bG
            end

            local bH = bD <= bu and 0 or bu

            if not a7.server and (not (bF.part and (bF.dmg >= bH or bF.dmg >= bD)) and (aC.backtrack or aC.forwardTrack)) then
                local function d(bI, bJ, bK, bL)
                    local bM, bN = mT(bp, bK, bs, br)

                    if not bM or bN > 0 and (not aC.rageAutowall and (not aC.wallbang and not aC.wallLimit)) then
                        return
                    end
                    if aC.wallLimit and bN > aC.maxWalls then
                        return
                    end

                    local bO = x(bq, bI, (bK - bp).Magnitude, aC.wallLimit and 0 or bN, bC.player)
                    local bP, bQ = R(bn.Name, bI, bN, bO)

                    if bP > bF.dmg then
                        bF = {
                            part = bJ,
                            dmg = bP,
                            raw = bO,
                            key = bQ,
                            walls = bN,
                            pos = bK,
                            track = bL,
                        }
                    end
                end

                if aC.backtrack then
                    local bI, bJ = bb[bC.player], os.clock()

                    if bI then
                        for bK = #bI - 1, 1, -2 do
                            local bL = bI[bK]
                            local bM = bJ - bL.t

                            if bM > aC.backtrackMs / 1000 then
                                break
                            end
                            if os.clock() - bo > bl then
                                break
                            end

                            for bN, bO in ipairs(bE)do
                                local bP, bQ = bC.char:FindFirstChild(bO), bL.pos[bO]

                                if bP and bQ then
                                    d(bO, bP, bQ, ('BT %dms'):format(bM * 1000))
                                end
                            end

                            if bF.pos and (bF.dmg >= bH or bF.dmg >= bD) then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if aC.forwardTrack and not (bF.pos and (bF.dmg >= bH or bF.dmg >= bD)) then
                    local bI = ba[bC.player]

                    if bI and bI.Magnitude > 1 then
                        for bJ, bK in ipairs{0.5, 1}do
                            if os.clock() - bo > bl then
                                break
                            end

                            local bL = (aC.forwardMs * bK) / 1000

                            for bM, bN in ipairs(bE)do
                                local bO = bC.char:FindFirstChild(bN)

                                if bO then
                                    d(bN, bO, bO.Position + bI * bL, ('FT %dms'):format(bL * 1000))
                                end
                            end

                            if bF.pos and (bF.dmg >= bH or bF.dmg >= bD) then
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if bF.part and (bF.dmg >= bH or bF.dmg >= bD) then
                bF.player, bF.char, bF.hp = bC.player, bC.char, bD
                bx[#bx + 1] = bF

                if not aC.rageMulti then
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        bk = bx[1] and bx[1].player or nil

        return bx
    end

    local bn, bo = {}, 0

    local function N(bp)
        local bq = os.clock()

        if bq - bo >= 1 / math.max(aC.rageScanHz, 1) then
            bo = bq
            bn = q(bp)
        else
            for br = #bn, 1, -1 do
                local bs = bn[br]

                if not bs.part.Parent or bs.char:GetAttribute'Dead' or t(bs.char) then
                    table.remove(bn, br)
                end
            end
        end

        return bn
    end

    local bp = Instance.new'Highlight'

    bp.FillTransparency = 1
    bp.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 120, 255)
    bp.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    bp.Enabled = false
    bp.Parent = aL

    local bq = Instance.new'BillboardGui'

    bq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 18)
    bq.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)
    bq.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bq.Enabled = false
    bq.Parent = aL

    local br = Instance.new'TextLabel'

    br.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    br.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    br.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    br.TextSize = 12
    br.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 160, 255)
    br.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
    br.Parent = bq

    aa.onUnload(function()
        bp:Destroy()
        bq:Destroy()
    end)

    local function b(bs)
        if setthreadidentity then
            pcall(setthreadidentity, 8)
        end

        local bt = aC.rageIndicator and bs ~= nil

        bp.Enabled = bt
        bq.Enabled = bt

        if not bt then
            return
        end

        bp.Adornee = bs.char
        bq.Adornee = bs.part

        local bu, bv = aK[bs.player] or 0, bs.dmg > 0 and math.ceil(bs.hp / bs.dmg) or 0

        br.Text = ('%s | %d hp | ~%d dmg | %d tap%s%s'):format(bs.player.Name, math.floor(bs.hp + 0.5), math.floor(bs.dmg + 0.5), bv, bs.walls > 0 and ' | ' .. (bs.walls .. (' wall' .. (bs.walls > 1 and 's' or ''))) or '', bu > 0 and ' | ' .. (bu .. ' miss') or '') .. (bs.track and ' | ' .. bs.track or '')
    end

    local bs, bt = 0, setmetatable({}, {
        __mode = 'k',
    })

    local function w(bu)
        if aC.rapidFire and aC.rapidUnlimited then
            return 0
        end

        local bv = tT(bu)

        if aC.rapidFire then
            bv = bv / math.max(aC.rapidMult, 1)
        end

        return bv
    end
    local function e()
        if aC.loopKill and aC.loopTarget then
            local bu = aa.byName(aC.loopTarget)
            local bv = bu and F(bu, 'Head')

            if bv and not t(bv) then
                return bv.Head
            end

            return nil
        end

        return nil
    end

    aa.connect(O.Heartbeat, function()
        bf, bg, bh = nil, nil, nil

        if m() then
            return
        end

        local bu = aC.loopKill and aC.loopTarget ~= nil or aC.killAll

        if not aC.rage and not bu then
            aC.rageStatus = nil

            return
        end

        local bv = p()

        if not bv or not bv.Bullet or not bv.Properties then
            aC.rageStatus = 'NO GUN'

            return
        end
        if aC.killAll and (not bv.IsReloading and (lU() and qU(bv))) then
            local bw = os.clock()

            for bx, by in ipairs(aa.entities())do
                if ET(by) then
                    local bz = F(by, 'Head')

                    if bz and (not t(bz) and bw - (bt[by] or 0) >= aC.killAllDelay) then
                        if (bv.Rounds or 0) <= 0 then
                            yU(bv)
                        end
                        if (bv.Rounds or 0) <= 0 then
                            break
                        end
                        if xU(bv, bz.Head, true) then
                            bt[by] = bw
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local bw = e()
        local bx = (not bw and aC.rage) and N(bv) or {}

        b(not bw and bx[1] or nil)

        bg = bw or bx[1] and bx[1].part or nil
        bh = not bw and (bx[1] and bx[1].pos) or nil
        bf = bh or bg and bg.Position

        if not bg then
            aC.rageStatus = (aC.rageCands or 0) > 0 and 'NO LINE' or 'NO TARGET'

            return
        end
        if not (bw or aC.rageAutoFire) then
            aC.rageStatus = 'AUTO OFF'

            return
        end
        if (bv.Rounds or 0) <= 0 or bv.IsReloading then
            aC.rageStatus = bv.IsReloading and 'RELOAD' or 'NO AMMO'

            return
        end
        if not qU(bv) then
            aC.rageStatus = 'EQUIP'

            return
        end
        if aC.rageRemote or bw then
            local by, bz = os.clock(), w(bv)

            if by - bs < bz then
                aC.rageStatus = ('WAIT %.1f'):format(bz - (by - bs))

                return
            end

            aC.rageStatus = 'FIRE'
            bs = by

            local bA = {}

            if bw then
                bA[1] = {part = bw}
            elseif aC.rageMulti then
                bA = bx
            else
                bA[1] = bx[1]
            end

            local bB = {}

            for bC, bD in ipairs(bA)do
                local bE = 1

                if aC.tapKill and (bD.hp and (bD.dmg and bD.dmg > 0)) then
                    bE = math.clamp(math.ceil(bD.hp / bD.dmg), 1, aC.maxTaps)
                end
                if aC.doubleTap and bE < 2 then
                    bE = 2
                end
                if bE > 1 then
                    bD.key = nil
                end

                for bF = 1, bE, 1 do
                    bB[#bB + 1] = bD
                end
            end

            local bC, bD = bz == 0 and (bv.Rounds or 1) or #bB, 0

            while bD < bC do
                local bE = bB[bD % #bB + 1]

                if (bv.Rounds or 0) <= aC.reloadAt and (aC.autoReload and aC.remoteReload) then
                    yU(bv)
                end
                if (bv.Rounds or 0) <= 0 then
                    break
                end
                if bE.player and bE.key then
                    aZ.expect(bE.player, bE.key, bE.raw)
                end

                xU(bv, bE.part, bw ~= nil or aC.wallbang, bE.pos)

                bD = bD + 1
            end

            if aC.doubleTap and (bD >= 2 and bz > 0) then
                bs = by + bz
            end
        elseif not aC.rapidFire and (not bv.IsShooting and not bv.IsFireHeld) then
            vU(false, bv)
        end
    end)
end
do
    local bi = 0

    aa.connect(O.Heartbeat, function()
        if not aC.rapidFire or m() then
            return
        end

        local bj = p()

        if not bj or not bj.Bullet or not bj.Properties then
            return
        end

        local bk, bl = bj.IsFireHeld == true, aC.rage and (aC.rageAutoFire and (bf ~= nil and not aC.rageRemote))

        if not (bk or bl) or (bj.Rounds or 0) <= 0 or bj.IsReloading then
            return
        end

        local bm = aC.rapidUnlimited and 0 or tT(bj) / math.max(aC.rapidMult, 1)

        if os.clock() - bi < bm then
            return
        end
        if bj.ShootDelayThread then
            pcall(task.cancel, bj.ShootDelayThread)
        end

        bj.ShootDelayThread = nil
        bj.IsShooting = false
        bj.NextShotDue = 0
        bi = os.clock()

        vU(bk, bj)
    end)
end
do
    local bi, bj = require(L.Classes.WeaponComponent.Classes.Viewmodel.Classes.Animation), nil

    bj = Q(bi.play, function(bk, bl, ...)
        local bm = bj(bk, bl, ...)

        if not aa.unloaded and (aC.instaReload and (bm and (type(bl) == 'string' and bl:find'^Reload'))) then
            pcall(function()
                bm:AdjustSpeed(aC.reloadSpeed)
            end)
        end

        return bm
    end)

    aa.connect(O.Heartbeat, function()
        if not aC.autoReload then
            return
        end

        local bk = p()
        local bl = bk and (bk.Capacity or 0) > 0 or workspace:GetAttribute'Gamemode' == 'Deathmatch'

        if bk and (bk.Bullet and (bk.Properties and ((bk.Rounds or 0) <= aC.reloadAt and (bl and ((bk.Rounds or 0) < (bk.Properties.Rounds or 0) and (not bk.IsReloading and not bk.IsShooting)))))) then
            if aC.remoteReload then
                yU(bk)
            else
                task.spawn(pcall, bk.reload, bk)
            end
        end
    end)
end
do
    local bi, bj = require(L.Components.Weapon.Classes.Bullet), nil

    bj = Q(bi.getTrueSpread, function(bk, ...)
        if not aa.unloaded and (aC.noSpread or bg ~= nil) then
            return 0
        end

        return bj(bk, ...)
    end)
end
do
    local bi = a2.Inventory and a2.Inventory.ShootWeapon

    if bi and type(bi.Send) == 'function' then
        local bj

        bj = Q(bi.Send, function(bk, ...)
            if aa.unloaded or type(bk) ~= 'table' or type(bk.Bullets) ~= 'table' then
                return bj(bk, ...)
            end
            if bk.__zamlblox then
                local bl = bk.__zamlblox

                bk.__zamlblox = nil

                pcall(function()
                    local bm = p()
                    local bn = bm and (bm.Properties and bm.Properties.Range) or 500

                    for bo, bp in ipairs(bk.Bullets)do
                        JT(bp.Origin, bp.Direction, bp.Hits or type(bl) == 'table' and bl[bo] or {}, bn)
                    end
                end)

                return bj(bk, ...)
            end

            do
                local bl = bk.Bullets[1]

                if type(bl) == 'table' then
                    local bm = bl.Hits == nil

                    if bm ~= a7.server then
                        a7.setServerHits(bm)
                    end
                end
            end

            pcall(function()
                local bl = p()
                local bm = bl and bl.Properties or {}
                local bn, bo, bp = bm.Range or 500, uT(bm), bg

                if not bp and aC.silentAim then
                    bp = aT()
                end

                local bq, br = U(), bp ~= nil or aH.active

                for bs, bt in ipairs(bk.Bullets)do
                    local bu

                    if br then
                        local bv = not a7.server and (bp ~= nil and (bp == bg and bh)) or nil
                        local bw, bx, by = (bp ~= nil and bp == bg) and (not bv and EU(bp) or LT()) or bq.Position, nil, nil

                        if bv then
                            bx = (bv - bw).Unit
                            by = jT(bw, bv, bp, bn, bo, aC.wallbang) or {}
                        else
                            bx = bp and (zU(bp) - bw).Unit or bq.LookVector
                            by = DT(bw, bx, bn, bo, bp, aC.wallbang and bp ~= nil)
                        end

                        bt.Origin, bt.Direction = bw, bx

                        if a7.server then
                            bu = by
                        else
                            bt.Hits = kT(bw, by)
                        end
                    elseif a7.server then
                        if typeof(bt.Origin) == 'Vector3' and (typeof(bt.Direction) == 'Vector3' and bt.Direction.Magnitude > 0) then
                            bu = DT(bt.Origin, bt.Direction.Unit, bn, bo, nil, false)
                        end
                    elseif aC.penMod and (typeof(bt.Origin) == 'Vector3' and (typeof(bt.Direction) == 'Vector3' and bt.Direction.Magnitude > 0)) then
                        bt.Hits = kT(bt.Origin, DT(bt.Origin, bt.Direction.Unit, bn, bo, nil, false))
                    end
                    if bt.Origin and bt.Direction then
                        JT(bt.Origin, bt.Direction, bu or bt.Hits or {}, bn)
                    end
                end
            end)

            return bj(bk, ...)
        end)
    end
end
do
    local bi = Instance.new'Folder'

    bi.Name = 'ZamlbloxESP'
    bi.Parent = aL

    local bj = Instance.new'Frame'

    bj.Name = 'ESP2D'
    bj.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    bj.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    bj.Parent = aL

    local bk, bl, bm, bn, bo, bp = {}, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 110), Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255), {
        {
            'Head',
            'UpperTorso',
        },
        {
            'UpperTorso',
            'LowerTorso',
        },
        {
            'UpperTorso',
            'LeftUpperArm',
        },
        {
            'LeftUpperArm',
            'LeftLowerArm',
        },
        {
            'LeftLowerArm',
            'LeftHand',
        },
        {
            'UpperTorso',
            'RightUpperArm',
        },
        {
            'RightUpperArm',
            'RightLowerArm',
        },
        {
            'RightLowerArm',
            'RightHand',
        },
        {
            'LowerTorso',
            'LeftUpperLeg',
        },
        {
            'LeftUpperLeg',
            'LeftLowerLeg',
        },
        {
            'LeftLowerLeg',
            'LeftFoot',
        },
        {
            'LowerTorso',
            'RightUpperLeg',
        },
        {
            'RightUpperLeg',
            'RightLowerLeg',
        },
        {
            'RightLowerLeg',
            'RightFoot',
        },
    }

    local function q(bq, br, bs)
        local bt = Instance.new'Frame'

        bt.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bt.BackgroundColor3 = bs or bl
        bt.Visible = false
        bt.ZIndex = br
        bt.Parent = bq

        return bt
    end
    local function v(bq, br)
        local bs = q(bq, br)

        bs.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

        return bs
    end
    local function K(bq)
        local br = Instance.new'TextLabel'

        br.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        br.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        br.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
        br.TextStrokeColor3 = bl
        br.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        br.Visible = false
        br.ZIndex = 4
        br.Parent = bq

        return br
    end
    local function N(bq, br, bs, bt, bu)
        bq.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(br, bs)
        bq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bt, bu)
        bq.Visible = true
    end
    local function c(bq, br, bs, bt, bu, bv, bw)
        local bx, by = bt - br, bu - bs

        bq.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((br + bt) / 2, (bs + bu) / 2)
        bq.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(bx * bx + by * by), bv)
        bq.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(by, bx))
        bq.BackgroundColor3 = bw
        bq.Visible = true
    end
    local function C(bq)
        local br = bk[bq]

        if br then
            br.highlight:Destroy()
            br.root:Destroy()
            br.outer:Destroy()

            bk[bq] = nil
        end
    end
    local function Q()
        for bq in pairs(bk)do
            C(bq)
        end
    end
    local function b(bq, br)
        C(bq)

        local bs = Instance.new'Highlight'

        bs.OutlineTransparency = 0
        bs.Adornee = br
        bs.Parent = bi

        local bt = Instance.new'Frame'

        bt.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        bt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        bt.Visible = false
        bt.Parent = bj

        local bu = Instance.new'Frame'

        bu.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        bu.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        bu.Parent = bj

        local bv = {
            highlight = bs,
            root = bt,
            outer = bu,
            char = br,
            vis = false,
            visAt = 0,
        }

        bv.fill = q(bt, 1)
        bv.fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
        bv.boxOut, bv.box = {}, {}

        for bw = 1, 8, 1 do
            bv.boxOut[bw] = q(bt, 2)
            bv.box[bw] = q(bt, 3)
        end

        bv.hpBack, bv.hpBar = q(bt, 2), q(bt, 3)
        bv.arBack, bv.arBar = q(bt, 2), q(bt, 3, bo)
        bv.hpText = K(bt)
        bv.hpText.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        bv.name, bv.weapon, bv.dist = K(bt), K(bt), K(bt)
        bv.flags = K(bt)
        bv.flags.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        bv.flags.RichText = true
        bv.flags.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        bv.flags.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        bv.bones = {}

        for bw = 1, #bp, 1 do
            bv.bones[bw] = v(bt, 2)
        end

        bv.headDot = q(bt, 3)
        bv.headDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        bv.headDot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        (Instance.new('UICorner', bv.headDot)).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        bv.headStroke = Instance.new('UIStroke', bv.headDot)
        bv.headStroke.Thickness = 1
        bv.snapOut, bv.snap = v(bu, 1), v(bu, 2)
        bv.arrow = {
            v(bu, 3),
            v(bu, 3),
        }

        local bw = {}

        local function N(bx, by, bz)
            bw[#bw + 1] = {bx, by, bz}
        end

        N(bv.fill, 'BackgroundTransparency', 0.82)

        for bx = 1, 8, 1 do
            N(bv.boxOut[bx], 'BackgroundTransparency', 0)
            N(bv.box[bx], 'BackgroundTransparency', 0)
        end

        for bx, by in ipairs{
            bv.hpBack,
            bv.hpBar,
            bv.arBack,
            bv.arBar,
            bv.snap,
            bv.arrow[1],
            bv.arrow[2],
        }do
            N(by, 'BackgroundTransparency', 0)
        end

        N(bv.snapOut, 'BackgroundTransparency', 0.5)

        for bx, by in ipairs{
            bv.hpText,
            bv.name,
            bv.weapon,
            bv.dist,
            bv.flags,
        }do
            N(by, 'TextTransparency', 0)
            N(by, 'TextStrokeTransparency', 0.35)
        end
        for bx, by in ipairs(bv.bones)do
            N(by, 'BackgroundTransparency', 0)
        end

        N(bv.headStroke, 'Transparency', 0)

        bv.fade, bv.alpha, bv.fadeApplied = bw, 0, -1
        bk[bq] = bv

        return bv
    end
    local function a(bq)
        local br = 1 - bq.alpha

        if br == bq.fadeApplied then
            return
        end

        bq.fadeApplied = br

        for bs, bt in ipairs(bq.fade)do
            bt[1][bt[2] ] = bt[3] + (1 - bt[3]) * br
        end
    end

    aa.connect(u.PlayerRemoving, C)
    aa.onUnload(Q)

    local function T(bq, br)
        local bs = bq:GetAttribute'CurrentEquipped'

        if bs ~= br.eqRaw then
            br.eqRaw = bs

            local bt, bu = pcall(ar.JSONDecode, ar, type(bs) == 'string' and bs or '')

            br.eqName = (bt and (type(bu) == 'table' and type(bu.Name) == 'string')) and bu.Name or nil
        end

        return br.eqName
    end
    local function w(bq, br)
        local bs = bq:GetAttribute'Armor'

        if bs ~= br.arRaw then
            br.arRaw = bs

            local bt, bu = pcall(ar.JSONDecode, ar, type(bs) == 'string' and bs or '')

            br.arValue = bt and (type(bu) == 'table' and tonumber(bu.Health)) or 0
            br.arHelmet = bt and (type(bu) == 'table' and (type(bu.Type) == 'string' and bu.Type:find'Helmet' ~= nil))
        end

        return br.arValue or 0
    end
    local function e(bq, br, bs, bt, bu, bv)
        local bw = aC.espBoxStyle == 'Full' and 0.5 or 0.25
        local bx, by = math.ceil(bt * bw), math.ceil(bu * bw)
        local bz = {
            {
                br,
                bs,
                bx,
                1,
            },
            {
                br,
                bs,
                1,
                by,
            },
            {
                (br + bt) - bx,
                bs,
                bx,
                1,
            },
            {
                (br + bt) - 1,
                bs,
                1,
                by,
            },
            {
                br,
                (bs + bu) - 1,
                bx,
                1,
            },
            {
                br,
                (bs + bu) - by,
                1,
                by,
            },
            {
                (br + bt) - bx,
                (bs + bu) - 1,
                bx,
                1,
            },
            {
                (br + bt) - 1,
                (bs + bu) - by,
                1,
                by,
            },
        }

        for bA = 1, 8, 1 do
            local bB = bz[bA]

            N(bq.boxOut[bA], bB[1] - 1, bB[2] - 1, bB[3] + 2, bB[4] + 2)
            N(bq.box[bA], bB[1], bB[2], bB[3], bB[4])

            bq.box[bA].BackgroundColor3 = bv
        end
    end
    local function o(bq, br, bs, bt, bu, bv, bw)
        local bx = br.Head
        local by = br:FindFirstChild'HumanoidRootPart' or bx
        local bz, bA = bx.Position, by.Position
        local bB = (bz - bu).Magnitude

        if bB > aC.espMaxDist and aC.espMaxDist < 3000 then
            bs.root.Visible, bs.outer.Visible, bs.highlight.Enabled = false, false, false

            return
        end
        if aC.espVisCheck and (not bt and not bs.dormant) then
            if bw - bs.visAt > 0.12 then
                bs.visAt = bw
                aU.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                    _.Character,
                    at,
                }

                local bC = workspace:Raycast(bu, bz - bu, aU)

                bs.vis = bC == nil or bC.Instance:IsDescendantOf(br)
            end
        else
            bs.vis = false
        end

        local bC

        if aC.espColorMode == 'Team Side' then
            local bD = bq:GetAttribute'Team'

            bC = bD == 'Terrorists' and aC.espTColor or bD == 'Counter-Terrorists' and aC.espCTColor or bt and aC.espTeamColor or aC.espEnemyColor
        elseif aC.espColorMode == 'Player Color' then
            local bD = bq:GetAttribute'CompetitivePlayerColor'

            bC = typeof(bD) == 'Color3' and bD or bt and aC.espTeamColor or aC.espEnemyColor
        else
            bC = bt and aC.espTeamColor or aC.espEnemyColor
        end
        if bs.vis then
            bC = aC.espVisColor
        end
        if bs.dormant then
            bC = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
        end

        local bD, bE, bF, bG = bs.highlight, aC.espFill, bC, aC.espChamsMode

        if bG == 'Outline' then
            bE = 1
        elseif bG == 'Solid' then
            bE = 0
        elseif bG == 'Pulse' then
            bE = 0.5 + 0.38 * math.sin(bw * 4.5)
        elseif bG == 'Rainbow' then
            bF = Color3.fromHSV((bw * 0.25) % 1, 0.85, 1)
        elseif bG == 'Health' then
            local bH = math.clamp(tonumber(br:GetAttribute'Health') or 100, 0, 100)

            bF = bn:Lerp(bm, bH / 100)
        end

        local bH = 1 - bs.alpha

        bD.Enabled = aC.espChams and not bs.dormant
        bD.DepthMode = aC.espChamsOccluded and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        bD.FillColor, bD.OutlineColor = bF, bF
        bD.FillTransparency = bE + (1 - bE) * bH
        bD.OutlineTransparency = bH

        local bI, bJ, bK = bA.Y - 3, br:FindFirstChild'LeftFoot', br:FindFirstChild'RightFoot'

        if bJ and bK then
            bI = math.min(bJ.Position.Y, bK.Position.Y) - bJ.Size.Y / 2
        end

        local bL, bM = at:WorldToViewportPoint(Vector3.new(bA.X, (bz.Y + bx.Size.Y / 2) + 0.25, bA.Z)), at:WorldToViewportPoint(Vector3.new(bA.X, bI, bA.Z))
        local bN = bM.Y - bL.Y
        local bO, bP = bN * 0.52, (bL.X + bM.X) / 2
        local bQ = bL.Z > 0 and (bM.Z > 0 and (bN > 2 and (bP + bO / 2 > 0 and (bP - bO / 2 < bv.X and (bM.Y > 0 and bL.Y < bv.Y)))))

        bs.outer.Visible = true

        local bR = aC.espArrows and not bQ

        bs.arrow[1].Visible, bs.arrow[2].Visible = bR, bR

        if bR then
            local bS = at.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(bA)
            local bU, bV = bS.X, -bS.Y
            local bW = math.sqrt(bU * bU + bV * bV)

            if bW < 0.001 then
                bU, bV, bW = 0, 1, 1
            end

            local bX = math.atan2(bV / bW, bU / bW)
            local bY, bZ = bv.X / 2 + math.cos(bX) * aC.espArrowRadius, bv.Y / 2 + math.sin(bX) * aC.espArrowRadius

            for b_ = 1, 2, 1 do
                local b0 = (bX + math.pi) + (b_ == 1 and 0.5 or -0.5)

                c(bs.arrow[b_], bY, bZ, bY + math.cos(b0) * aC.espArrowSize, bZ + math.sin(b0) * aC.espArrowSize, 2, bC)
            end
        end

        local bS = aC.espSnap and bQ

        bs.snap.Visible, bs.snapOut.Visible = bS, bS

        if bS then
            local bU = aC.espSnapFrom == 'Top' and 0 or aC.espSnapFrom == 'Center' and bv.Y / 2 or bv.Y

            c(bs.snapOut, bv.X / 2, bU, bP, bM.Y, 3, bl)

            bs.snapOut.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5

            c(bs.snap, bv.X / 2, bU, bP, bM.Y, 1, bC)
        end

        bs.root.Visible = bQ

        if not bQ then
            return
        end

        local bU, bV = math.floor(bP - bO / 2), math.floor(bL.Y)

        bO, bN = math.floor(bO), math.floor(bN)

        if aC.espBox then
            e(bs, bU, bV, bO, bN, bC)
        else
            for bW = 1, 8, 1 do
                bs.boxOut[bW].Visible, bs.box[bW].Visible = false, false
            end
        end

        bs.fill.Visible = aC.espBoxFill

        if aC.espBoxFill then
            N(bs.fill, bU, bV, bO, bN)

            bs.fill.BackgroundColor3 = bC
        end

        local bW = math.clamp(tonumber(br:GetAttribute'Health') or 100, 0, 100)

        bs.hpBack.Visible, bs.hpBar.Visible = aC.espHealth, aC.espHealth
        bs.hpText.Visible = aC.espHealth and (aC.espHealthText and bW < 100)

        if aC.espHealth then
            local bX = math.max(math.floor((bN * bW) / 100), 1)

            N(bs.hpBack, bU - 6, bV - 1, 4, bN + 2)
            N(bs.hpBar, bU - 5, (bV + bN) - bX, 2, bX)

            bs.hpBar.BackgroundColor3 = bn:Lerp(bm, bW / 100)

            if bs.hpText.Visible then
                bs.hpText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bU - 8, (bV + bN) - bX)
                bs.hpText.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 10)
                bs.hpText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
                bs.hpText.TextSize = math.max(aC.espTextSize - 2, 9)
                bs.hpText.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                bs.hpText.Text = tostring(math.floor(bW + 0.5))
            end
        end

        local bX, bY = (bV + bN) + 2, aC.espArmor and w(bq, bs) or 0
        local bZ = aC.espArmor and bY > 0

        bs.arBack.Visible, bs.arBar.Visible = bZ, bZ

        if bZ then
            N(bs.arBack, bU - 1, bX, bO + 2, 4)
            N(bs.arBar, bU, bX + 1, math.max(math.floor((bO * math.clamp(bY, 0, 100)) / 100), 1), 2)

            bX = bX + 5
        end

        local b_ = aC.espTextSize

        bs.name.Visible = aC.espNames

        if aC.espNames then
            bs.name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bP, (bV - b_) - 4)
            bs.name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, b_ + 2)
            bs.name.TextSize, bs.name.TextColor3 = b_, bs.dormant and bC or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            bs.name.Text = bs.dormant and ('%s  %.0fs ago'):format(bq.DisplayName, bw - (bs.dormantAt or bw)) or bq.DisplayName
        end

        local b0 = aC.espWeapon and T(bq, bs)

        bs.weapon.Visible = b0 ~= nil and b0 ~= false

        if bs.weapon.Visible then
            bs.weapon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bP, bX)
            bs.weapon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, b_ + 2)
            bs.weapon.TextSize, bs.weapon.TextColor3, bs.weapon.Text = b_, bC, b0
            bX = (bX + b_) + 1
        end

        bs.dist.Visible = aC.espDistance

        if aC.espDistance then
            bs.dist.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(bP, bX)
            bs.dist.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, b_ + 2)
            bs.dist.TextSize, bs.dist.TextColor3 = math.max(b_ - 1, 9), Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 215)
            bs.dist.Text = math.floor(bB * 0.28) .. 'm'
        end

        bs.flags.Visible = aC.espFlags

        if aC.espFlags then
            local b1, b2 = {}, w(bq, bs)

            if b2 > 0 then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#6FB4FF">' .. ((bs.arHelmet and 'HK' or 'K') .. '</font>')
            end

            local b3 = tonumber(bq:GetAttribute'Money')

            if b3 then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#7CE38B">$' .. (math.floor(b3) .. '</font>')
            end
            if (tonumber(bq:GetAttribute'ScopeIncrement') or 0) > 0 then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#5CE1E6">ZOOM</font>'
            end
            if bq:GetAttribute'HasDefuseKit' == true then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#C9A6FF">KIT</font>'
            end
            if bq:GetAttribute'IsCrouching' == true then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#D0D0D8">DUCK</font>'
            end
            if t(br) then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#FFD35C">IMMUNE</font>'
            end
            if type(bq) == 'table' and bq.IsBot then
                b1[#b1 + 1] = '<font color="#9A9AA5">BOT</font>'
            end

            local b4 = math.max(b_ - 2, 9)

            bs.flags.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((bU + bO) + 4, bV - 1)
            bs.flags.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, #b1 * (b4 + 1) + 2)
            bs.flags.TextSize = b4
            bs.flags.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            bs.flags.Text = table.concat(b1, ' ')
        end

        bs.headDot.Visible = aC.espHeadDot

        if aC.espHeadDot then
            local b1, b2 = at:WorldToViewportPoint(bz), math.max(math.floor(bN * 0.13), 4)

            bs.headDot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b1.X, b1.Y)
            bs.headDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(b2, b2)
            bs.headStroke.Color = bC
        end

        for b1, b2 in ipairs(bp)do
            local b3, b4, b5 = bs.bones[b1], aC.espSkeleton and br:FindFirstChild(b2[1]), aC.espSkeleton and br:FindFirstChild(b2[2])

            if b4 and b5 then
                local b6, b7 = at:WorldToViewportPoint(b4.Position), at:WorldToViewportPoint(b5.Position)

                if b6.Z > 0 and b7.Z > 0 then
                    c(b3, b6.X, b6.Y, b7.X, b7.Y, 1, bC)
                else
                    b3.Visible = false
                end
            else
                b3.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    aa.connect(O.RenderStepped, function(bq)
        if not aC.esp then
            if next(bk) then
                Q()
            end

            return
        end

        local br, bs, bt = (U()).Position, at.ViewportSize, os.clock()

        for bu, bv in ipairs(aa.entities())do
            local bw = bv ~= _ and k(bv)
            local bx = bv ~= _ and (not bw or aC.espTeam)
            local by, bz = bx and F(bv), false

            if not by and (bx and (not bw and aC.espDormant)) then
                local bA, bB = bv.Character, bk[bv]

                if bA and (bB and (bB.char == bA and (not bA:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and (not bA:GetAttribute'Dead' and (bv:GetAttribute'Dead' == false and bA:FindFirstChild'Head'))))) then
                    bB.dormantAt = bB.dormantAt or bt

                    if bt - bB.dormantAt <= aC.espDormantTime then
                        by, bz = bA, true
                    end
                end
            end

            local bA, bB = bk[bv], 1

            if by then
                if not bA or bA.char ~= by then
                    bA = b(bv, by)
                end
                if not bz then
                    bA.dormantAt = nil
                end

                bA.dormant = bz
            elseif bA and (bx and (bA.char and (bA.char:FindFirstChild'Head' and (bA.char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or (bA.alpha or 0) > 0)))) then
                bA.goneAt = bA.goneAt or bt

                if bt - bA.goneAt > 3 then
                    C(bv)

                    bA = nil
                else
                    by, bB = bA.char, 0
                    bA.dormant = false
                end
            else
                C(bv)

                bA = nil
            end
            if bA and by then
                if bB == 1 then
                    bA.goneAt = nil
                end
                if aC.espFade <= 0 then
                    bA.alpha = bB
                elseif bA.alpha < bB then
                    bA.alpha = math.min(bA.alpha + bq / aC.espFade, bB)
                else
                    bA.alpha = math.max(bA.alpha - bq / aC.espFade, bB)
                end
                if bB == 0 and bA.alpha <= 0 then
                    bA.root.Visible, bA.outer.Visible, bA.highlight.Enabled = false, false, false
                else
                    local bC = pcall(o, bv, by, bA, bw, br, bs, bt)

                    if not bC then
                        bA.root.Visible, bA.outer.Visible = false, false
                    end

                    a(bA)
                end
            end
        end

        local bu = aa.entities()

        for bv in pairs(bk)do
            if not table.find(bu, bv) then
                C(bv)
            end
        end
    end)
end

    return aC
end


-- ═══════════════ ZRHUB: new silent aim (+ auto shoot, wallbang) and movement ═══════════════
ZR_SHI = nil
function ZR_GetShitaro()
    if ZR_SHI ~= nil then return ZR_SHI or nil end
    local ok, res = pcall(ZR_LoadShitaro)
    if ok and type(res) == "table" then
        ZR_SHI = res
    else
        warn("[ZRHUB] silent aim backend failed: " .. tostring(res))
        ZR_SHI = false
    end
    return ZR_SHI or nil
end

function ZR_BuildHome(Library, Window)
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    local tab = Window:AddTab("Home", "house")
    local me = tab:AddLeftGroupbox("ZRHUB", "user-round")
    local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    avatar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    avatar.Size = UDim2.new(1.4, 0, 1.4, 0)
    avatar.Position = UDim2.new(-0.2, 0, -0.2, 0)
    avatar.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarThumbnail&id=" .. tostring(lp.UserId) .. "&w=420&h=420"
    local pass
    pcall(function() pass = me:AddUIPassthrough("ZR_HomeAvatar", { Instance = avatar, Height = 225 }) end)
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, image = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(lp.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarThumbnail, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size420x420)
        end)
        if ok and type(image) == "string" then pcall(function() avatar.Image = image end) end
        task.wait(0.1)
        local parent = avatar.Parent
        if parent and pass then
            local function fit()
                local x = parent.AbsoluteSize.X
                if x > 0 then pcall(function() pass:SetHeight(math.clamp(x, 180, 270)) end) end
            end
            fit()
            parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
        end
    end)
    local statsBox = tab:AddRightGroupbox("Statistics", "blinds")
    local lTime = statsBox:AddLabel("Current time: <b>--:--</b>")
    local lFps = statsBox:AddLabel("FPS: <b>--</b>")
    local lPing = statsBox:AddLabel("Ping: <b>-- ms</b>")
    statsBox:AddDivider()
    local lPlayers = statsBox:AddLabel("Players in server: <b>--</b>")
    local lElapsed = statsBox:AddLabel("Elapsed time: <b>0 seconds</b>")
    local started, frames = tick(), 0
    local fc = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function() frames += 1 end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while not Library.Unloaded do
            task.wait(1)
            local fps = frames
            frames = 0
            pcall(function() lTime:SetText(string.format("Current time: <b>%s</b>", os.date("%H:%M"))) end)
            pcall(function() lFps:SetText("FPS: <b>" .. fps .. "</b>") end)
            pcall(function() lPing:SetText("Ping: <b>" .. math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() + 0.5) .. " ms</b>") end)
            pcall(function() lPlayers:SetText("Players in server: <b>" .. #Players:GetPlayers() .. " / " .. Players.MaxPlayers .. "</b>") end)
            pcall(function() lElapsed:SetText("Elapsed time: <b>" .. math.floor(tick() - started) .. " seconds</b>") end)
        end
        fc:Disconnect()
    end)
end

ZR_ZAML = nil
function ZR_GetZaml()
    if ZR_ZAML ~= nil then return ZR_ZAML or nil end
    local ok, res = pcall(ZR_LoadZaml)
    if ok and type(res) == "table" then
        ZR_ZAML = res
    else

        ZR_ZAML = false
    end
    return ZR_ZAML or nil
end

function ZR_BuildSilentAim(Library, obsTab)
    local box = obsTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Silent Aim", "crosshair")
    -- the old silent aim stays switched off; this one replaces it
    local B = ZR_GetShitaro()
    if B and B.aim then
        for k, v in pairs(B.aim) do if v == true then B.aim[k] = false end end
    end
    local cfg = ZR_GetZaml()
    if not cfg then
        box:AddLabel("Silent aim couldn't start on this executor.", true)
        return
    end
    cfg.silentAim, cfg.showFov, cfg.fov, cfg.aimPart = false, false, 120, "Head"
    cfg.wallCheck, cfg.teamCheck, cfg.fovColor = true, true, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

    box:AddToggle("ZRS_On", { Text = "Silent Aim", Default = false, Callback = function(v) cfg.silentAim = v end })
        :AddKeyPicker("ZRS_OnKey", { Default = "None", SyncToggleState = true, Mode = "Toggle", Text = "Silent Aim" })
    box:AddSlider("ZRS_Fov", { Text = "FOV Radius", Min = 10, Max = 600, Default = 120, Rounding = 0, Suffix = " px",
        Callback = function(v) cfg.fov = v end })
    box:AddToggle("ZRS_ShowFov", { Text = "Show FOV Circle", Default = false, Callback = function(v) cfg.showFov = v end })
        :AddColorPicker("ZRS_FovCol", { Default = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Title = "FOV Color", Callback = function(c) cfg.fovColor = c end })
    box:AddDropdown("ZRS_Part", { Text = "Aim Part", Values = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Closest to Crosshair", "Random" }, Default = "Head",
        Callback = function(v) cfg.aimPart = v end })
    box:AddToggle("ZRS_Wall", { Text = "Wall Check", Default = true, Callback = function(v) cfg.wallCheck = v end })
    box:AddToggle("ZRS_Team", { Text = "Team Check", Default = true, Callback = function(v) cfg.teamCheck = v end })
end

function ZR_BuildMovement(Library, Window)
    local tab = Window:AddTab("Movement", "footprints")
    local box = tab:AddLeftGroupbox("Movement", "footprints")
    local B = ZR_GetShitaro()
    if not B or not B.move then
        box:AddLabel("Movement couldn't start on this executor.", true)
        return
    end
    local cfg = B.move
    local list = {
        { "bhop", "Bunny Hop" }, { "strafe", "Auto Strafe" }, { "edge_jump", "Edge Jump" }, { "jump_bug", "Jump Bug" },
        { "edge_bug", "Edge Bug" }, { "slow_walk", "Slow Walk" }, { "pixel_surf", "Pixel Surf" },
    }
    for _, e in ipairs(list) do
        local key, text = e[1], e[2]
        cfg[key] = false
        box:AddToggle("ZRM_" .. key, { Text = text, Default = false, Callback = function(v) cfg[key] = v end })
            :AddKeyPicker("ZRM_" .. key .. "Key", { Default = "None", SyncToggleState = true, Mode = "Toggle", Text = text })
    end
end

	-- ================= Obsidian adapter =================
	-- Same API the rest of the script calls (Create / Tab / Section / Toggle / Slider /
	-- Dropdown / Colorpicker / Keybind / Settings / TextBox / Button / Label, Flags,
	-- GetConfig / LoadConfig / GetSkinConfig / LoadSkinConfig), drawn with Obsidian.
	local repo = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deividcomsono/Obsidian/main/"
	local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. "Library.lua"))()
	local ThemeManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. "addons/ThemeManager.lua"))()
	local Options, Toggles = Library.Options, Library.Toggles
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

	getgenv().theme_event = getgenv().theme_event or Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	getgenv().theme = getgenv().theme or {
		accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), risky = Color3.fromRGB(237, 77, 77),
		playerlist = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), scroll = Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255),
		bg = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22), card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 23, 30),
		text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 250), muted = Color3.fromRGB(130, 140, 160), name = "Dark",
	}
	getgenv().SavedSkins = getgenv().SavedSkins or {}

	local lib = { Flags = {}, ConfigFlags = {}, Obsidian = Library }
	getgenv().uishit = lib
	local flagCount = 0
	function lib:GetNextFlag()
		flagCount = flagCount + 1
		return "ndlc_" .. flagCount
	end

	-- menu key helpers the script expects
	getgenv().CurrentMenuKey = "RightShift"
	getgenv().SetZRHUBMouseUnlock = function() end
	getgenv().SetMenuKeybind = function(key)
		getgenv().CurrentMenuKey = key or "RightShift"
		pcall(function() Options.MenuKeybind:SetValue({ key or "RightShift", "Toggle" }) end)
	end
	getgenv().ToggleMenuVisibility = function() pcall(function() Library:Toggle() end) end

	-- ---------- config (same format as the old UI) ----------
	function lib:GetConfig()
		local out = {}
		for flag in pairs(lib.ConfigFlags) do
			local v = lib.Flags[flag]
			if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
				out[flag] = { v:ToHex() }
			elseif typeof(v) ~= "EnumItem" then
				out[flag] = v
			end
		end
		out._SkinConfig = { SkinConfig = getgenv().SkinConfig, SavedSkins = getgenv().SavedSkins }
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(out)
	end
	function lib:LoadConfig(json)
		local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(json)
		for flag, v in pairs(data) do
			local setter = lib.ConfigFlags[flag]
			if setter then pcall(setter, v) end
		end
		if data._SkinConfig then
			if data._SkinConfig.SkinConfig then getgenv().SkinConfig = data._SkinConfig.SkinConfig end
			if data._SkinConfig.SavedSkins then getgenv().SavedSkins = data._SkinConfig.SavedSkins end
			if lib.RefreshSkinGrid then task.defer(lib.RefreshSkinGrid) end
		end
	end
	function lib:GetSkinConfig()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode({ SkinConfig = getgenv().SkinConfig, SavedSkins = getgenv().SavedSkins })
	end
	function lib:LoadSkinConfig(json)
		local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(json)
		local d = data._SkinConfig or data
		if d.SkinConfig then getgenv().SkinConfig = d.SkinConfig end
		if d.SavedSkins then getgenv().SavedSkins = d.SavedSkins end
		if lib.RefreshSkinGrid then task.defer(lib.RefreshSkinGrid) end
	end

	-- ---------- helpers ----------
	local function roundingFor(step)
		step = tonumber(step) or 1
		if step >= 1 then return 0 end
		local s = tostring(step)
		local dec = s:match("%.(%d+)")
		return dec and math.min(#dec, 3) or 0
	end
	local function toList(v)
		if type(v) ~= "table" then return {} end
		local list = {}
		for k, on in pairs(v) do
			if type(k) == "number" then list[#list + 1] = on elseif on then list[#list + 1] = k end
		end
		return list
	end
	local function asColor(v)
		if typeof(v) == "Color3" then return v end
		if type(v) == "table" and type(v[1]) == "string" then
			local ok, c = pcall(Color3.fromHex, v[1])
			if ok then return c end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local SECTION_ICONS = {
		{ "aim", "crosshair" }, { "bullet", "crosshair" }, { "global", "globe" }, { "exploit", "zap" },
		{ "trigger", "mouse-pointer-click" }, { "esp", "scan-eye" }, { "player", "users" }, { "world", "sun" },
		{ "sky", "cloud" }, { "hit", "target" }, { "chams", "paintbrush" }, { "view", "hand" },
		{ "movement", "footprints" }, { "misc", "layers" }, { "config", "save" }, { "skin", "palette" },
		{ "menu", "menu" }, { "camera", "camera" }, { "effect", "sparkles" }, { "anti", "shield" },
	}
	local function iconFor(name)
		local n = tostring(name):lower()
		for _, pair in ipairs(SECTION_ICONS) do
			if n:find(pair[1], 1, true) then return pair[2] end
		end
		return "box"
	end

	-- a do-nothing object (used for the old theme sections, Obsidian has its own themes)
	local dummy
	dummy = setmetatable({ Flag = "dummy", Container = nil }, {
		__index = function(_, k)
			if k == "Value" then return nil end
			return function() return dummy, dummy end
		end,
	})

	local makeSection

	local function addColorpicker(gb, parentToggleId, o)
		o = o or {}
		local id = lib:GetNextFlag()
		local default = o.default or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local trans = o.transparency or 0
		local opts = {
			Default = default, Title = o.title,
			Callback = function(c)
				lib.Flags[id] = c
				if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, c, trans) end
			end,
		}
		if parentToggleId and Toggles[parentToggleId] then
			Toggles[parentToggleId]:AddColorPicker(id, opts)
		else
			gb:AddLabel(o.title or "color"):AddColorPicker(id, opts)
		end
		lib.Flags[id] = default
		lib.ConfigFlags[id] = function(v)
			local c = asColor(v)
			if c then Options[id]:SetValue(c) end
		end
		if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, default, trans) end
		return id
	end

	makeSection = function(gb, parentToggleId)
		local S = {}

		function S:Toggle(o)
			o = o or {}
			local id = lib:GetNextFlag()
			local default = o.default == true
			gb:AddToggle(id, {
				Text = o.title or "toggle", Default = default, Risky = o.risky == true,
				Tooltip = (o.info and o.infotext) or nil,
				Callback = function(v)
					lib.Flags[id] = v
					if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, v) end
				end,
			})
			lib.Flags[id] = default
			lib.ConfigFlags[id] = function(v) Toggles[id]:SetValue(v == true) end
			if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, default) end

			local T = makeSection(gb, id)
			T.Flag = id
			function T:Set(v) Toggles[id]:SetValue(v == true) end
			function T:Get() return Toggles[id].Value end
			function T:Settings(_) return T end
			function T:Colorpicker(co) addColorpicker(gb, id, co) return T end
			function T:Keybind(ko)
				ko = ko or {}
				local key = ko.key or ko.default or "None"
				if typeof(key) == "EnumItem" then key = key.Name end
				pcall(function()
					Toggles[id]:AddKeyPicker(id .. "_key", {
						Default = key, SyncToggleState = true, Mode = ko.mode or "Toggle", Text = ko.title or o.title,
					})
				end)
				return T
			end
			return T
		end

		function S:Slider(o)
			o = o or {}
			local id = lib:GetNextFlag()
			local minV, maxV = tonumber(o.min) or 0, tonumber(o.max) or 100
			if maxV < minV then minV, maxV = maxV, minV end
			local default = math.clamp(tonumber(o.default) or minV, minV, maxV)
			gb:AddSlider(id, {
				Text = o.title or "slider", Min = minV, Max = maxV, Default = default,
				Rounding = roundingFor(o.float or o.step), Suffix = o.suffix,
				Callback = function(v)
					lib.Flags[id] = v
					if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, v) end
				end,
			})
			lib.Flags[id] = default
			lib.ConfigFlags[id] = function(v) if tonumber(v) then Options[id]:SetValue(tonumber(v)) end end
			if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, default) end
			local obj = { Flag = id }
			function obj:Set(v) Options[id]:SetValue(v) end
			return obj
		end

		function S:Dropdown(o)
			o = o or {}
			local id = lib:GetNextFlag()
			local multi = o.multi == true
			local values = type(o.values) == "table" and o.values or {}
			local function fire(v)
				local out = multi and toList(v) or v
				lib.Flags[id] = out
				if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, out) end
			end
			gb:AddDropdown(id, {
				Text = o.title or "dropdown", Values = values, Multi = multi, AllowNull = true, Searchable = #values > 8,
				Callback = fire,
			})
			-- default
			local d = o.default
			pcall(function()
				if multi then
					local set = {}
					if type(d) == "table" then for _, x in ipairs(d) do set[x] = true end
					elseif type(d) == "string" and d ~= "" then set[d] = true end
					Options[id]:SetValue(set)
				elseif d ~= nil and d ~= "" and table.find(values, d) then
					Options[id]:SetValue(d)
				end
			end)
			if multi then
				local list = type(d) == "table" and d or ((type(d) == "string" and d ~= "") and { d } or {})
				lib.Flags[id] = list
				if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, list) end
			else
				lib.Flags[id] = d
				if o.callback and d ~= nil then pcall(o.callback, d) end
			end
			lib.ConfigFlags[id] = function(v)
				if multi then
					local set = {}
					for _, x in ipairs(type(v) == "table" and v or {}) do set[x] = true end
					Options[id]:SetValue(set)
				else
					Options[id]:SetValue(v)
				end
			end
			local obj = { Flag = id }
			function obj:Refresh(list) pcall(function() Options[id]:SetValues(list or {}) end) end
			obj.RefreshValues = obj.Refresh
			obj.UpdateList = obj.Refresh
			function obj:Set(v)
				if multi then
					local set = {}
					for _, x in ipairs(type(v) == "table" and v or { v }) do set[x] = true end
					Options[id]:SetValue(set)
				else
					Options[id]:SetValue(v)
				end
			end
			return obj, obj
		end

		function S:TextBox(o)
			o = o or {}
			local id = lib:GetNextFlag()
			local title = (o.title and o.title ~= "NO TITLE") and o.title or (o.placeholder or "text")
			gb:AddInput(id, {
				Text = title, Default = o.default or "", Placeholder = o.placeholder or "",
				ClearTextOnFocus = o.ClearTextOnFocus == true, Finished = true,
				Callback = function(v)
					lib.Flags[id] = v
					if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, v) end
				end,
			})
			lib.Flags[id] = o.default or ""
			lib.ConfigFlags[id] = function(v) Options[id]:SetValue(tostring(v or "")) end
			local obj = { Flag = id }
			function obj:Set(v) Options[id]:SetValue(tostring(v or "")) end
			return obj
		end

		function S:Button(o)
			o = o or {}
			gb:AddButton({ Text = o.title or "button", Func = function() if o.callback then pcall(o.callback) end end })
			return S
		end

		function S:Label(o)
			local text = type(o) == "table" and (o.text or o.title) or tostring(o)
			local l = gb:AddLabel(text, true)
			local obj = {}
			function obj:Set(t) pcall(function() l:SetText(t) end) end
			obj.ChangeText = obj.Set
			return obj
		end

		function S:Colorpicker(o)
			addColorpicker(gb, parentToggleId, o)
			return S
		end

		function S:Keybind(o)
			o = o or {}
			local id = lib:GetNextFlag()
			local key = o.key or o.default or "None"
			if typeof(key) == "EnumItem" then key = key.Name end
			gb:AddLabel(o.title or "keybind"):AddKeyPicker(id, {
				Default = key, Mode = o.mode or "Toggle", Text = o.title or "keybind",
				Callback = function(v) if o.callback then pcall(o.callback, v) end end,
			})
			return { Flag = id }
		end

		function S:StandaloneKeybind(o)
			o = o or {}
			gb:AddLabel(o.title or "menu key"):AddKeyPicker("MenuKeybind", {
				Default = o.key or "RightShift", NoUI = true, Text = o.title or "menu key",
			})
			Library.ToggleKeybind = Options.MenuKeybind
			return { Flag = "MenuKeybind" }
		end

		function S:Settings(_) return S end
		return S
	end

	-- ---------- the skins page: the script draws its own big grid, so it gets its own panel ----------
	local function makeSkinsSection(obsTab)
		local parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "ZRHUB_SkinPanel"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		gui.Enabled = false
		pcall(function() gui.Parent = parent end)
		if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560, 470)
		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.5, -235)
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22)
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Draggable = true
		panel.Parent = gui
		Instance.new("UICorner", panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", panel)
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 54, 68)

		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 30)
		title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0)
		title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = "Skin Changer"
		title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 250)
		title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		title.TextSize = 14
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		title.Parent = panel

		local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
		close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
		close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 3)
		close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 56)
		close.Text = "X"
		close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		close.TextSize = 12
		close.Parent = panel
		Instance.new("UICorner", close).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() gui.Enabled = false end)

		local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -40)
		scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 34)
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 400)
		scroll.Parent = panel

		local sectionFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
		sectionFrame.Name = "SkinsSection"
		sectionFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(510, 310)
		sectionFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sectionFrame.Parent = scroll

		local container = Instance.new("Frame")
		container.Name = "Container"
		container.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
		container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
		container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		container.Parent = sectionFrame
		local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", container)
		list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
		list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

		local box = obsTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Skins", "palette")
		box:AddLabel("The skin changer has its own window because of its big grid.", true)
		box:AddButton({ Text = "Open / Close Skin Changer", Func = function() gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled end })
		Library:OnUnload(function() pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end)

		local S = makeSection(box)
		S.Container = container
		return S
	end

	-- ---------- window / tabs ----------
	local TAB_ICONS = { combat = "crosshair", visuals = "eye", misc = "layers", skins = "palette", settings = "settings" }
	function lib:Create(o)
		local Window = Library:CreateWindow({
			Title = "ZRHUB",
			Footer = "Blox Strike",
			Icon = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=129949624640047&w=150&h=150",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(740, 600),
			NotifySide = "Right",
			ShowCustomCursor = true,
			Center = true,
			AutoShow = true,
		})
		pcall(ZR_BuildHome, Library, Window)
		local win = {}
		local movementBuilt = false
		function win:Tab(name, special)
			local label = tostring(name):gsub("^%l", string.upper)
			if tostring(name):lower() == "visuals" and not movementBuilt then
				movementBuilt = true
				local ok, err = pcall(ZR_BuildMovement, Library, Window)
				if not ok then warn("[ZRHUB] movement tab: " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
			local obsTab = Window:AddTab(label, TAB_ICONS[tostring(name):lower()] or "folder")
			local tab = {}
			local skins
			local silentBuilt = tostring(name):lower() ~= "combat"
			function tab:Section(sname, side)
				if special then
					skins = skins or makeSkinsSection(obsTab)
					return skins
				end
				local key = tostring(sname):lower()
				if key == "theme" or key == "theme colors" then
					return dummy -- Obsidian themes are on this tab instead
				end
				-- the new silent aim box goes first on the combat tab; the old one is gone
				if not silentBuilt then
					silentBuilt = true
					local ok, err = pcall(ZR_BuildSilentAim, Library, obsTab)
					if not ok then warn("[ZRHUB] silent aim box: " .. tostring(err)) end
				end
				-- the old silent aim box is replaced by the new Silent Aim box
				if key == "silent aim" then return dummy end
				local gb = (side == "right") and obsTab:AddRightGroupbox(sname, iconFor(sname))
					or obsTab:AddLeftGroupbox(sname, iconFor(sname))
				local sec = makeSection(gb)
				return sec
			end
			if tostring(name):lower() == "settings" then
				task.defer(function()
					local m = obsTab:AddRightGroupbox("Menu", "menu")
					m:AddToggle("ShowCustomCursor", { Text = "Custom Cursor", Default = true,
						Callback = function(v) Library.ShowCustomCursor = v end })
					m:AddButton({ Text = "Unload Menu", Func = function() Library:Unload() end })
					if not Options.MenuKeybind then
						-- hidden: the "menu key" in the menu box sets this one
						local bindLabel = m:AddLabel("Menu bind")
						bindLabel:AddKeyPicker("MenuKeybind", { Default = "RightShift", NoUI = true, Text = "Menu keybind" })
						pcall(function() bindLabel:SetVisible(false) end)
					end
					Library.ToggleKeybind = Options.MenuKeybind
					ThemeManager:SetLibrary(Library)
					ThemeManager:SetFolder("ZRHUB")
					ThemeManager:ApplyToTab(obsTab)
					ThemeManager:ApplyTheme("Jester")

					-- Credits (last tab)
					local creditsTab = Window:AddTab("Credits", "user")
					local CreditsBox = creditsTab:AddLeftGroupbox("Credits", "user")
					CreditsBox:AddLabel("Made by tung zo1os", true)
					CreditsBox:AddButton({
						Text = "Copy Discord Link",
						Func = function()
							pcall(setclipboard, "https://discord.gg/TCuMcKy9j4")
							Library:Notify({ Title = "Copied!", Description = "Discord link copied.", Time = 3 })
						end,
					})
				end)
			end
			return tab
		end
		return win
	end

	return lib

  end self._frames+=1 self._elapsed+=_bxb or 0
  if self._elapsed>=self.update_interval then self.fps=math.floor(self._frames/self._elapsed+0.5)self._frames=0 self._elapsed=0
    local _bxc=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _bxd,_bxe=pcall(function()
      return _bxc:GetNetworkPing()*1000
    end)self.ping=_bxd and math.max(0,math.floor(_bxe+0.5))or 0
    if self._label then self._label.Text=string.format("ZRHUB | FPS: %d | PING: %dms",self.fps,self.ping)
    end

    end
  end

  end

end function _byl:draw_player(_bzb)
  if not _bzb or not _bzb.Character then return
  end
  local _bzc=_bzb.Character
  local _bzd=_bzc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local _bze=_bzc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local _bzf=_bzc:FindFirstChild("Head")
  if not _bzd or not _bze or _bzd.Health<=0 then return
  end
  local _bzg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
  if self.teamcheck and _bzb.Team==_bzg.Team then return
  end
  local _bzh=workspace.CurrentCamera
  local _bzi=_bzg.Character and _bzg.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local _bzj=_bzi and(_bzi.Position-_bze.Position).Magnitude or 0
  if self.max_distance and _bzj>self.max_distance then return
  end
  local _bzk=self._sound_markers and self._sound_markers[_bzb]
  if _bzk and _bzk.until_t and tick()<_bzk.until_t and _bzk.pos then end
  local _bzl,_bzm=_bzh:WorldToViewportPoint(_bze.Position)

    if self.sound_esp and Drawing and type(Drawing.new)=="function"then local _bzn=(_bze.Position-_bzh.CFrame.Position).Unit
      local _bzo=_bzh.ViewportSize/2
      local _bzp=math.atan2(_bzn.X,-_bzn.Z)

    end

  end
  local _bzt=self.enemy_color self:update_chams(_bzb,_bzc,_bzt)
  local _bzu=_bzh:WorldToViewportPoint((_bzf and _bzf.Position or _bze.Position)+Vector3.new(0,0.5,0))
  local _bzv=_bzh:WorldToViewportPoint(_bze.Position-Vector3.new(0,3,0))

  end
  if self.show_health then self:add_text("HP: "..math.floor(_bzd.Health),Vector2.new(_bzy.X,_bzy.Y-_bzw/2-14),12,self.text_color)
  end
  if self.show_healthbar then local _bzA=math.clamp(_bzd.Health/math.max(_bzd.MaxHealth,1),0,1)
    local _bzB=_bzy.X-_bzx/2-6 self:add_line(Vector2.new(_bzB,_bzy.Y+_bzw/2),Vector2.new(_bzB,_bzy.Y-_bzw/2),Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40),4)self:add_line(Vector2.new(_bzB,_bzy.Y+_bzw/2),Vector2.new(_bzB,_bzy.Y+_bzw/2-_bzw*_bzA),Color3.fromRGB(80,255,80),3)

  if self.show_head_dot and _bzf then local _bzD,_bzE=_bzh:WorldToViewportPoint(_bzf.Position)
    if _bzE then if Drawing and type(Drawing.new)=="function"then local _bzF=Drawing.new("Circle")_bzF.Color=_bzt;_bzF.Radius=3;_bzF.Filled=true;_bzF.Position=Vector2.new(_bzD.X,_bzD.Y)table.insert(self.esp_objects,_bzF)

    end

end function _byl:update()
  if not self.enabled then return
  end
  if not Drawing or type(Drawing.new)~="function"then return
  end
  local _bzG=os.clock()
  if self._last_update and _bzG-self._last_update<(self.update_interval or 0.10)then return
  end self._last_update=_bzG self:clear_drawings()
  local _bzH={}
  local _bzI=game:GetService("Players")
  local _bzJ=_bzI.LocalPlayer
  for _bzK,_bzL in ipairs(_bzI:GetPlayers())do if _bzL~=_bzJ then _bzH[_bzL]=true pcall(function()self:draw_player(_bzL)
      end)
    end
  end
  for _bzM,_bzN in pairs(self.chams)do if not _bzH[_bzM]or not _bzM.Character then if _bzN then pcall(function()_bzN:Destroy()
        end)
      end self.chams[_bzM]=nil
    end
  end
